## Airbus First Quarter (Q1) 2026 financial results

At a glance

> The Q1 results reflect the lower level of commercial aircraft deliveries and a strong performance
> in our Defence and Space division. The operating environment remains dynamic and complex. We are
> closely monitoring the potential impact from the fast-changing situation in the Middle East. In
> commercial aircraft, we continue to ramp up and produce as per our plan while navigating the
> shortage of Pratt & Whitney engines.

[Image]

### Flight Training

At ACS Aviation, we are a global leader in airline pilot training. Thanks to our experienced
instructors and our state-of-the-art facilities in the UK, our graduates are highly sought after by
airlines across the world.

[Image]

### Engineering

ACS Aviation provides reliable and robust aircraft maintenance, technical services and parts
services that are designed to keep our own fleet and our customers’ aircraft airborne and safe.

[Image]

### Perth Airport

Perth Airport is located in Scotland and convenient to the major cities of Edinburgh, Glasgow, and
Aberdeen; Perth Airport is an ideal location both for the business traveller and for the General
Aviation community.

### About Us

ACS Aviation have been training pilots since 2007 and is the UK's leading Flight Training
Organisation. We also offer specialist aircraft maintenance services through our engineering
division, ACS Engineering. We are a fully approved CAA Part CAO aircraft maintenance provider in
Scotland, specialising in the support of fixed wing piston aircraft. Perth Airport is the largest
and busiest General Aviation airport in Scotland, located 3 miles north-east of Perth, Scotland. The
airport is operated by ACS Aviation Ltd and is used for private aircraft, business aircraft and for
advanced pilot training.

### Flight Training

At ACS Aviation, we are a global leader in airline pilot training. Thanks to our experienced
instructors and our state-of-the-art facilities in the UK, our graduates are highly sought after by
airlines across the world.

[Image]

### Engineering

ACS Aviation provides reliable and robust aircraft maintenance, technical services and parts
services that are designed to keep our own fleet and our customers’ aircraft airborne and safe.

[Image]

### Perth Airport

Perth Airport is located in Scotland and convenient to the major cities of Edinburgh, Glasgow, and
Aberdeen; Perth Airport is an ideal location both for the business traveller and for the General
Aviation community.

### About Us

ACS Aviation have been training pilots since 2007 and is the UK's leading Flight Training
Organisation. We also offer specialist aircraft maintenance services through our engineering
division, ACS Engineering. We are a fully approved CAA Part CAO aircraft maintenance provider in
Scotland, specialising in the support of fixed wing piston aircraft. Perth Airport is the largest
and busiest General Aviation airport in Scotland, located 3 miles north-east of Perth, Scotland. The
airport is operated by ACS Aviation Ltd and is used for private aircraft, business aircraft and for
advanced pilot training.

## Welcome to Adams Aviation

Adams Aviation has been supplying items in support of the aviation industry since 1968, offering an
ever increasing level of expertise, an expanding portfolio of products and a commitment to customer
satisfaction unequalled in the aviation community. Our core business is the same day despatch from
stock of aircraft components with full certification to trade customers including airlines,
operators, maintenance companies, armed forces and aircraft manufacturers around the world.

We now have a CAA-Part 145 accredited Repair Centre which stands as a cornerstone in providing
indispensable services to the general, commercial and helicopter aviation industry, specialising in
the maintenance of headsets, helmets and essential equipment such as ELTs. In addition, we cater to
airport ground handling companies, air ambulance units, SAR heli-operators, and private pilots,
ensuring their equipment meets the highest standards of performance and reliability.

**Location**

Our offices are located in the vibrant locale of Crawley, offering not only a dynamic work
environment but also the added advantage of being in close proximity to Gatwick Airport.
**Aeropia House, 2 Kelvin Road, Crawley, West Sussex, RH10 9TY. UK.**

[Welcome]
[Veryon]

[Get in Touch][211]

## Adams Aviation Repair Centre

Adams Aviation is an authorised warranty service centre for **David Clark**, **Lightspeed**, and
**Bose**, upholding the highest industry standards. This recognition establishes us as a dependable
provider skilled in precise and careful handling of aviation headsets. Our repair processes feature
thorough testing and quality assurance to ensure the reliability and safety of each headset.

**Approvals:** Adams Aviation is ISO9001:2015 certified and holds CAA Part 145 and EASA Part 145
maintenance approvals for ELT reprogramming and battery changes. Our accreditations with Bureau
Veritas and the UK CAA guarantee reliability, traceability, and confidentiality.
1. **ISO9001:2015** - This accreditation affirms our commitment to consistently delivering
   high-quality products and services.
2. **CAA Part 145** - Allows us to perform maintenance, inspection, and repair of aviation headsets.

When sending us your repairs, please remember to complete our **[REPAIR FORM][212]** and include it
with the item(s).

[Repair Centre]

Follow us on our social media channels **[LinkedIn][213]** | **[Instagram][214]** |

products, exclusive deals, behind-the-scenes content from our repair centre, and updates from
industry events we attend. It’s the best way to stay connected and see how Adams Aviation continues
to support pilots, engineers, and aviation professionals across the globe.

## Welcome to Adams Aviation

Adams Aviation has been supplying items in support of the aviation industry since 1968, offering an
ever increasing level of expertise, an expanding portfolio of products and a commitment to customer
satisfaction unequalled in the aviation community. Our core business is the same day despatch from
stock of aircraft components with full certification to trade customers including airlines,
operators, maintenance companies, armed forces and aircraft manufacturers around the world.

We now have a CAA-Part 145 accredited Repair Centre which stands as a cornerstone in providing
indispensable services to the general, commercial and helicopter aviation industry, specialising in
the maintenance of headsets, helmets and essential equipment such as ELTs. In addition, we cater to
airport ground handling companies, air ambulance units, SAR heli-operators, and private pilots,
ensuring their equipment meets the highest standards of performance and reliability.

**Location**

Our offices are located in the vibrant locale of Crawley, offering not only a dynamic work
environment but also the added advantage of being in close proximity to Gatwick Airport.
**Aeropia House, 2 Kelvin Road, Crawley, West Sussex, RH10 9TY. UK.**

[Welcome]
[Veryon]

[Get in Touch][211]

## Adams Aviation Repair Centre

Adams Aviation is an authorised warranty service centre for **David Clark**, **Lightspeed**, and
**Bose**, upholding the highest industry standards. This recognition establishes us as a dependable
provider skilled in precise and careful handling of aviation headsets. Our repair processes feature
thorough testing and quality assurance to ensure the reliability and safety of each headset.

**Approvals:** Adams Aviation is ISO9001:2015 certified and holds CAA Part 145 and EASA Part 145
maintenance approvals for ELT reprogramming and battery changes. Our accreditations with Bureau
Veritas and the UK CAA guarantee reliability, traceability, and confidentiality.
1. **ISO9001:2015** - This accreditation affirms our commitment to consistently delivering
   high-quality products and services.
2. **CAA Part 145** - Allows us to perform maintenance, inspection, and repair of aviation headsets.

When sending us your repairs, please remember to complete our **[REPAIR FORM][212]** and include it
with the item(s).

[Repair Centre]

## Follow Us

Follow us on our social media channels **[LinkedIn][213]** | **[Instagram][214]** |
**[YouTube][215]** | **[Facebook][216]** | **[X][217]** to stay up to date with the latest aviation
products, exclusive deals, behind-the-scenes content from our repair centre, and updates from
industry events we attend. It’s the best way to stay connected and see how Adams Aviation continues
to support pilots, engineers, and aviation professionals across the globe.

[Home Image]

## Mission-Ready Systems Spotlight

[Mako Lite product image]
01Atlas
02Disruptor
03Raker

01 – 06

### Atlas

Atlas is a Group II autonomous precision strike system engineered for tactical dominance.
Lightweight yet powerful, Atlas achieves payload-to-GTOW ratios that rival larger aircraft while
delivering standoff reach and precision effects at the speed of modern warfare. Frontline-ready,
Atlas is engineered to need and delivered at speed—giving warfighters a decisive edge in contested
and denied environments.

### Disruptor

Disruptor is a next-generation autonomous precision strike system engineered for extended endurance,
adaptable range, and multi-domain versatility. It supports missions from precision attack to ISR,
communications relay, and electronic warfare, all while operating reliably in GPS-denied and
contested environments. Designed for rapid deployment and precision effects, Disruptor delivers
dominance at the speed of modern conflict.

### Raker

Raker is a long-endurance, fixed-wing UAS built for sustained missions and rapid deployment.
Combining digital engineering, modular design, and additive manufacturing, it delivers exceptional
range, payload capacity, and reliability. Produced through AEVEX’s Drone Factory of the Future,
Raker enables scalable, mission-ready capability that meets modern operational demands with speed
and precision.

### Vandal

Vandal is a next-generation, low-signature UAS built for speed, precision, and survivability in
denied environments. Featuring vision-based navigation, electric propulsion, and RF-transparent
materials, it delivers autonomous performance and operational stealth. Additive manufacturing
enables rapid, scalable production of complex systems at the edge, embodying AEVEX’s Drone Factory
of the Future.

### Mariana

Mariana delivers long-endurance ISR capability built for the modern battlespace. Its open
architecture, autonomous operation, and modular payload design give forces the flexibility to adapt,
respond, and maintain persistent awareness across extended missions. Proven engineering and
redundant systems ensure reliability in denied or dynamic environments, supporting mission success
when it matters most.

### Mako Lite

Mako Lite is a lightweight, expeditionary unmanned surface vessel designed for agile maritime
operations. Compact, affordable, and easily deployable, it delivers reliable ISR, logistics, and
communications support in dynamic environments. Built with modular architecture and autonomous
control, Mako Lite provides scalable capability for nearshore and extended missions, enabling rapid
response and persistent awareness across a range of naval and joint operations.

[Home Image]
Advanced Autonomy

## CompassX Powers the Future of Mission Autonomy

CompassX is AEVEX’s open standards, AI-driven navigation and autonomy platform that unites crewed
and uncrewed systems for unmatched precision, awareness, and resilience. From GPS-denied navigation
to autonomous targeting and guidance, CompassX and its family of solutions deliver assured
performance across every domain.

[Explore CompassX][89]

## Proof in Performance

AEVEX delivers mission advantage through scale, precision, and proven performance. From autonomous
systems and ISR operations to aircraft engineering and global mission support, we operate where
speed, reliability, and dominance define success.

## Mission-Ready Systems Spotlight

[Mako Lite product image]
01Atlas
02Disruptor

01 – 06

### Atlas

Atlas is a Group II autonomous precision strike system engineered for tactical dominance.
Lightweight yet powerful, Atlas achieves payload-to-GTOW ratios that rival larger aircraft while
delivering standoff reach and precision effects at the speed of modern warfare. Frontline-ready,
Atlas is engineered to need and delivered at speed—giving warfighters a decisive edge in contested
and denied environments.

### Disruptor

Disruptor is a next-generation autonomous precision strike system engineered for extended endurance,
adaptable range, and multi-domain versatility. It supports missions from precision attack to ISR,
communications relay, and electronic warfare, all while operating reliably in GPS-denied and
contested environments. Designed for rapid deployment and precision effects, Disruptor delivers
dominance at the speed of modern conflict.

### Raker

Raker is a long-endurance, fixed-wing UAS built for sustained missions and rapid deployment.
Combining digital engineering, modular design, and additive manufacturing, it delivers exceptional
range, payload capacity, and reliability. Produced through AEVEX’s Drone Factory of the Future,
Raker enables scalable, mission-ready capability that meets modern operational demands with speed
and precision.

### Vandal

Vandal is a next-generation, low-signature UAS built for speed, precision, and survivability in
denied environments. Featuring vision-based navigation, electric propulsion, and RF-transparent
materials, it delivers autonomous performance and operational stealth. Additive manufacturing
enables rapid, scalable production of complex systems at the edge, embodying AEVEX’s Drone Factory
of the Future.

### Mariana

Mariana delivers long-endurance ISR capability built for the modern battlespace. Its open
architecture, autonomous operation, and modular payload design give forces the flexibility to adapt,
respond, and maintain persistent awareness across extended missions. Proven engineering and
redundant systems ensure reliability in denied or dynamic environments, supporting mission success
when it matters most.

### Mako Lite

Mako Lite is a lightweight, expeditionary unmanned surface vessel designed for agile maritime
operations. Compact, affordable, and easily deployable, it delivers reliable ISR, logistics, and
communications support in dynamic environments. Built with modular architecture and autonomous
control, Mako Lite provides scalable capability for nearshore and extended missions, enabling rapid
response and persistent awareness across a range of naval and joint operations.

[Home Image]
Advanced Autonomy

## CompassX Powers the Future of Mission Autonomy

CompassX is AEVEX’s open standards, AI-driven navigation and autonomy platform that unites crewed
and uncrewed systems for unmatched precision, awareness, and resilience. From GPS-denied navigation
to autonomous targeting and guidance, CompassX and its family of solutions deliver assured
performance across every domain.

[Explore CompassX][89]

## Proof in Performance

AEVEX delivers mission advantage through scale, precision, and proven performance. From autonomous
systems and ISR operations to aircraft engineering and global mission support, we operate where
speed, reliability, and dominance define success.

## Global Supplier

Aircom Aviation is a leading global aircraft parts supplier providing personalized service, quality
products, and expedited deliveries.

## Consulting Services

We offer consulting services for companies looking to start a program or those interested in
improving an already existing one.

## Asset Management

Let our sales team monetize your assets to their fullest.

# About Us

Welcome to Aircom Aviation Services, LLC – a global aircraft parts supplier providing personalized
service, quality products and expedited deliveries. We specialize in the sale, consignment and
distribution of regional and commercial aircraft and engine parts, as well as industrial gas turbine
engines and parts used for power generation.

We also offer consulting services for companies and airlines looking to start a new program or
improve an already existing one. We list our inventory on numerous international databases giving us
access to customers all over the world. Our “on shelf” inventory enables us to fill many orders from
stock, allowing rapid shipments and customer satisfaction that we pride ourselves on.

The Aircom Aviation team has a combined 75+ years of experience in the aviation supply service
sector. Our knowledge of the aftermarket business and global contacts, together with
state-of-the-art technology, allow us to provide our valued customers with the highest possible
standard of service which they have come to expect over the years.

#### Engine Parts

Aircom Aviation specializes in turbine engine parts, with a focus on CFMI and GE engine shrouds.
Please contact us to get a quote on your HPT shrouds, or learn about how to save 40% or more on your
IAE HPT blades. We work with Pratt & Whitney, GE, CFMI and IAE to maximize the life of your engine
hardware, to keep your aircraft where they are supposed to be, in the air.

[Aircraft Rotables]

#### Aircraft Rotables

Let Aircom help you purchase parts through our vast network of vendors and distributors. We
specialize in hard to find parts for Airbus, Boeing, Bombardier, Embraer and ATR. Contact us today
to learn more about how we can help you get the parts you need when you need them, so you can focus
on your customers.

#### Consignments

Aircom manages engine and airframe inventories for airlines, MROs, lessors, and financial
institutions. We have customers in the US, Europe, and Asia, helping you maximize the margins on
your rotable and expendable inventories. Contact Aircom today to learn more about our customer
focused consignment programs to help you achieve the best possible returns on your investment.

# Services

#### Distribution

Our distribution business stocks a wide variety of engine hardware purchased from leading aerospace
manufacturers. In particular, our emphasis on building relationships with our vendors as well as our
customers is key to our ability to deliver value throughout our supply chain.

Another way Aircom Aviation supports our Airline customers and vendors is by offering Asset
Management. We have current ongoing consignments and can offer you many ways to help store and
manage your inventory!

#### Repair/PMA Management

We have built a strong network around the globe that allow us to be extremely competitive with
repair and overhaul pricing as well as great turn around times. If you are in need of some repair
management, please contact us and see how we can assist!

Supplier of aircraft components to airlines, MRO’s, repair shops and dealers, covering all major
Aircraft and Engine types. We buy/sell all types of parts from the smallest diode to a complete
airframe. All parts are available for sale, exchange, or lease. We pride ourselves on being flexible
to find the right solution for our customers.

In addition, we have PMA capabilities that allow us to Reverse Engineer and/or Manufacture PMA
parts. These parts are widely accepted in the US market, and usage is increasing overseas as well.
Let us assist you in decreasing your cost from new OEM part prices with these FAA approved
alternatives!

#### Our Customers

In business it’s important to always be at the forefront of your field, pioneering new ways of
working and service that exceeds the customer’s expectations. That’s why at Aircom Aviation, we
believe that our most important relationship is with you, our customer.

## Providing the highest quality standard of aircraft and engine parts to our global customers
* Incorporated Est. 1999, family owned and operated
* Fast response for RFQs
* Marketing expertise
* Same-day shipping available
* Open and available for distribution/consignment opportunities

# OUR STORY

There was a time, aircraft mechanics were the unsung heroes of the aviation industry. They worked
tirelessly behind the scenes to ensure that every flight was safe and successful, yet their hard
work often went unnoticed. That’s when a group of passionate and dedicated aircraft mechanics came
together to create Aircraft Engineer Info, an organization dedicated to giving these unsung heroes
the recognition they deserve.

Aircraft Engineer Info began as a resource for mechanics during the transition period from ICAO type
2 license to EASA part 66. But with the dedication of its team members, the organization has grown
to become the leading provider of services for aircraft mechanics worldwide. We offer consultation
services to help establish Aircraft Line Maintenance Organizations, preparing them with
documentation such as engineering manuals and Maintenance Organization Exposition.

Aircraft Engineer Info is also the only organization in the world that speaks out on the working
conditions and pay of aircraft mechanics. We believe in setting recognized standards for the
industry, covering working facilities, contracts, recruitment processes, working hours, and
compensation. Aircraft engineer info believe in equal opportunities based on a candidate’s ability,
rather than the widely practiced culture in the aviation industry’s human resource environment.

At Aircraft Engineer Info, we believe that aircraft mechanics are the technically responsible heroes
behind every successful flight. We strive to give these heroes the recognition they deserve and are
committed to creating a better future for them. we are the voice of the unsung heroes, and our
tagline says it all: “Technically the HERO”.

## Mission

To improve the standards of aircraft maintenance professionals by providing comprehensive digital
resources and educational opportunities, thereby enhancing the safety and efficiency of the aviation
industry.

## Vision

Our vision is to become the leading digital platform for aircraft maintenance professionals by
providing access to innovative tools, training, and knowledge resources, enabling them to excel in
their profession and meet the demands of the aviation industry.

## Our Services

#### Aircraft Engineering training and Coaching
1.  Basic aircraft maintenance training (EASA Part 66)
2.  Aircraft Maintenance Engineering type training
3.  General Familiarization of the Aircraft
4.  Aircraft Engineering continuation training
5.  Safety training
6.  Quality and compliance training
7.  Aircraft maintenance Post holder training
8.  Software/Systems training
9.  Aviation legislation Training
10. Stores inspection training

#### Aviation Personal Recruitment
1.  Certifying Aircraft Engineers/Technicians/Mechanics ( CAT A B & C)
2.  Non certifying Aircraft Mechanics
3.  Quality and compliance personals
4.  Safety personals
5.  Training instructors
6.  Post holders
7.  Aircraft Maintenance Planners
8.  Stores and logistic Personals
9.  Airworthiness inspectors
10. MCC Engineers

#### Aircraft Engineering Consultation
1. Aircraft Line Maintenance Set up
2. Recommendation of Tools and Equipment
3. Maintenance Organization Exposition
4. Aircraft Maintenance Engineering Procedure
5. Quality/compliance System establishment
6. Documentation of Forms and tags
7. Establishment of procedures and manuals
8. Training materials

#### Compliance Audit
1. Independent Audit

## The Spirit of Flight

United by our passion for aviation engineering, AIS is driven to provide industry operators with
cutting-edge design solutions built upon strategic global alliance production platforms across all
regions.

## About us

AIS is comprised from international industry experts with cumulative experience encompassing the
majority of major global OEMs. AIS pivots on modern aviation integrations business-models, providing
low-CAPEX and low-risk turn-key solutions. Our solutions encompass design, production and
certifications, assuring longevity and sustainability of each programme.

## Our Expertise

Purpose-built solutions are achieved by our dedicated Integrations team representing comprehensive
expertise within the Aerospace, Civil and Defence industries.

Aircraft Integrated Solutions, along with our partners, delivers best-in-class, full-service
engineering and production solutions across all disciplines.

## Our strategic focus is based upon purpose-built solutions to meet sustainable
## market requirements.

## Our Goals & Values

Together, driven by the 4 crucial pillars of the aviation industry KPI’s in concert with the ever
evolving technology landscape; Safety, Budget Schedule and Quality, we strive to achieve end-to-end
program efficiency.

* Provide best-in-class aviation products and solutions for global market niches.

# sky is the limit

*We are a team of aircraft mechanics, specialized on interior aircraft solutions.*

## over 20 years in the industry

Dedicated team of professionals with over 20 years of combined experienced on **custom interior
aircraft solutions**. A privately owned company providing aircraft maintenance, aircraft servicing,
and interior access for all types of airframe.

## WHAT WE DO:
* Interior access in all type of airframes for maintenance.
* Seats adjustments, refurbishment, custom textures and/or sewing designs.
* Cabinetry major and minor repairs, new coatings and imperfection repairs.
* Carpet cleaning, custom fitting and runners.
* Reupholstery of headliners, deco panels, recovery of dado panels, cabin side walls, etc.
* Plating of latches, handles, hinges, light covers, etc,
* Much More…
  
  ***See our ***[***SERVICES***][14]*** tab for more details***

## Schedule flights, track data and connect your private flight department.

[Get Started][12]
[[Play Video]][13]

### Over 18 years in the Industry

Welcome to Airplane Manager, a comprehensive flight scheduling and management software designed
exclusively for the private jet industry. Airplane Manager pioneered web-based scheduling software
in this industry, and today, it continues to lead by providing the most advanced and cutting-edge
software solutions available.

1332 Flight Departments
4088 Aircraft
32377 Active Users
4842 FBOs

### Flight Scheduling Software Designed For You

Introducing the first web-based flight scheduling software crafted exclusively for corporate jets
since 2009. Our mission is to offer intuitive software that seamlessly connects pilots, passengers,
owners, and executive assistants.

### Flight Dispatch and Scheduling Solutions with In-Flight Crew Connections (IFCC) – Dispatch
### Services®

Looking for reliable and flexible flight dispatch and scheduling services? Discover what In-Flight
Crew Connections – Dispatch Services has to offer!

As a fully integrated Flight Dispatch Operations Center, IFCC specializes in providing tailored
remote dispatching and scheduling services designed to your flight department's requirements.

Whether you're in need of additional scheduling assistance or a full-service dispatch center, IFCC
offers a subscription plan to meet your needs.

#### Trust In-Flight Crew Connections to provide exceptional support for Airplane Manager customers.

[Find Out More][17]

### Global Trip Support and Jet Fuel Services with EVO Flight Services – Trip Support & Fuel

Need worldwide trip support, ground handling, and competitively priced jet fuel from a single
partner? See what EVO Flight Services brings to your flight department.

With more than 30 years in business aviation, EVO is a U.S.-owned provider of international trip
support, ground handling arrangements, and global jet fuel — backed by offices in Houston, Las
Vegas, and Prague and a worldwide network of aviation specialists.

From custom flight plans, permits, and APIS filings to detailed airport briefings and fuel at over
3,000 locations worldwide, EVO's planning tools — Flight Compass, BriefMe, 3D Airport Briefings,
NOTAMizer, and Fuel Web — give operators everything they need for a smooth international trip.

#### Trust EVO Jet Services to provide exceptional support for Airplane Manager customers.

[JSSI logo placeholder]

### Hourly Cost Maintenance Programs and Aviation Financial Services with JSSI – Maintenance, Parts
### & Advisory

Looking for predictable maintenance budgeting and independent expertise for your aircraft? Discover
what Jet Support Services, Inc. (JSSI) has to offer.

Founded in 1989, JSSI is the largest independent provider of maintenance programs, parts, leasing,
software, and financial services to business aviation — supporting roughly 30% of the world's
business jets.

Whether you need an Hourly Cost Maintenance (Power by the Hour) program for your engines, APU, or
airframe, parts and engine leasing support, or maintenance tracking software through TRAXXALL and
Conklin & de Decker, JSSI offers a tailored solution to match your operation.

#### Trust JSSI to provide exceptional support for Airplane Manager customers.

# Simple. Intuitive. Comprehensive. Affordable.

## Schedule flights, track data and connect your private flight department.

[Get Started][12]
[[Play Video]][13]

### Over 18 years in the Industry

Welcome to Airplane Manager, a comprehensive flight scheduling and management software designed
exclusively for the private jet industry. Airplane Manager pioneered web-based scheduling software
in this industry, and today, it continues to lead by providing the most advanced and cutting-edge
software solutions available.

1332 Flight Departments
4088 Aircraft
32377 Active Users
4842 FBOs

### Flight Scheduling Software Designed For You

Introducing the first web-based flight scheduling software crafted exclusively for corporate jets
since 2009. Our mission is to offer intuitive software that seamlessly connects pilots, passengers,
owners, and executive assistants.

[

### All the features you were missing

[Icon of a laptop and a mobile phone] Modern App Features
* 100% Progressive Web Based App
* User Role Security Restrictions
* Designed for mobile phones & tablets
* E-Signature features
* Maintenance API
[Icon of a laptop and a mobile phone] Collaborative Tooling
* Document sharing
* Staff & Crew Schedule Calendar
* Calendar sync with Google Calendar, iCal, Outlook
* Trip Messaging / Chat
* Passenger Profiles
[Icon of a laptop and a mobile phone] Data & Analytics
* Flight tracking
* Expense tracking with Quickbooks integration
* Time & Duty Log
* Aircraft Flight Logs
* Pilot Tracking
* Aircraft due items & Squawks
* Tripsheets & Passenger Itineraries
* Robust reports & exports
[Icon of a laptop and a mobile phone] Management & Operations
* Flight plan filing
* International Handling
* eAPIS (Direct Filing and FlashPass)
* Customs forms population
* FRAT
* Airport lookup with flight times, drive times, drive distances and cheapest fuel
* Fuel Stop Map selection
* Worldwide Airport Directory
* North American FBO Directory
* Preferred FBO Network with fuel discounts
* Contract fuel price shopping

### Flight Dispatch and Scheduling Solutions with In-Flight Crew Connections (IFCC) – Dispatch
### Services®

Looking for reliable and flexible flight dispatch and scheduling services? Discover what In-Flight
Crew Connections – Dispatch Services has to offer!

As a fully integrated Flight Dispatch Operations Center, IFCC specializes in providing tailored
remote dispatching and scheduling services designed to your flight department's requirements.

Whether you're in need of additional scheduling assistance or a full-service dispatch center, IFCC
offers a subscription plan to meet your needs.

#### Trust In-Flight Crew Connections to provide exceptional support for Airplane Manager customers.

[Find Out More][17]

### Global Trip Support and Jet Fuel Services with EVO Flight Services – Trip Support & Fuel

Need worldwide trip support, ground handling, and competitively priced jet fuel from a single
partner? See what EVO Flight Services brings to your flight department.

With more than 30 years in business aviation, EVO is a U.S.-owned provider of international trip
support, ground handling arrangements, and global jet fuel — backed by offices in Houston, Las
Vegas, and Prague and a worldwide network of aviation specialists.

From custom flight plans, permits, and APIS filings to detailed airport briefings and fuel at over
3,000 locations worldwide, EVO's planning tools — Flight Compass, BriefMe, 3D Airport Briefings,
NOTAMizer, and Fuel Web — give operators everything they need for a smooth international trip.

#### Trust EVO Jet Services to provide exceptional support for Airplane Manager customers.

[JSSI logo placeholder]

### Hourly Cost Maintenance Programs and Aviation Financial Services with JSSI – Maintenance, Parts
### & Advisory

Looking for predictable maintenance budgeting and independent expertise for your aircraft? Discover
what Jet Support Services, Inc. (JSSI) has to offer.

Founded in 1989, JSSI is the largest independent provider of maintenance programs, parts, leasing,
software, and financial services to business aviation — supporting roughly 30% of the world's
business jets.

Whether you need an Hourly Cost Maintenance (Power by the Hour) program for your engines, APU, or
airframe, parts and engine leasing support, or maintenance tracking software through TRAXXALL and
Conklin & de Decker, JSSI offers a tailored solution to match your operation.

#### Trust JSSI to provide exceptional support for Airplane Manager customers.

# AME CET 2026

AME CET stands for Aircraft Maintenance Engineering Common Entrance Test. Basically it is a common
entrance exam of national level for pursuing aviation courses. AME CET offers admission in India’s
top most institute/ university for pursuing aviation courses in India. AME CET is the platform where
participants choose any institution according to their All India Rank of AME CET. AME CET offers to
the participants to take admission in license, diploma, certificate & graduation courses of the
aviation sector. AME CET offers upto 100% scholarship to all qualified students.

Through AME CET participants pursue the course of [Pilot][44], [Aircraft Maintenance
Engineering][45], [Aeronautical Engineering][46], [Aerospace Engineering][47], [BBA in
Aviation][48], [B.Sc in Aviation][49], etc. These courses have bright scope. Aviation sector is one
of the fastest growing industries and it’s the right time to make your career in this sector. After
pursuing these courses you are a part of an ever-evolving industry.

AME CET conducts an examination and on behalf of All India Rank(AIR) participants choose an aviation
institute or university to pursue the aviation course according to their choice. The institution of
the courses is approved through the Directorate General of Civil Aviation, govt. Of India(DGCA),
University Grants Commission of India (UGC India), All India Council for Technical Education(AICTE).

AME CET 2026 Exam important dates on the following [AME CET 2026 Exam Important Dates][50] and for
more info about exam details like [eligibility][51], [syllabus][52], [exam pattern][53],
[examination fees][54], [exam centers][55], etc.

To know about the application process [click learn more about the AME CET registration process][56]
and participants also download our e brochure from [AME CET 2026 Brochure.][57]

##### What is the AME CET Exam for?

AME CET stands for Aircraft Maintenance Engineering Common Entrance Test. AME CET is conducted to
provide admissions in various aviation courses like Aircraft Maintenance Engineering, Aeronautical
Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, etc. The colleges/universities/institutes, where admissions are
provided through AME CET are one of the highly recognized varsities that are approved by the
Ministry of Civil Aviation, Govt of India, AICTE, and UGC. To learn more about the available courses
and student eligibility, visit the [AME CET Courses and Eligibility page][105].

##### What is the Scope of AME CET?

A candidate who aspires to take the AME CET will be able to take admission to one of the premium
institutes/colleges/universities in PAN India. Furthermore, the institutions in which one will be
able to take admission are approved by the authorities like UGC, AICTE, and DGCA etc. Also, these
institutions provide placements to renowned firms with a good package.

## COMMERCIAL REAL ESTATE &
## OTHER ASSET CLASSES

Commercial real estate owners (and other asset classes as well) select Assets America® for their
transactional and commercial loan financing needs. And, they know they are engaging a firm that
possesses the knowledge, the credibility, and the long-term, sophisticated relationships with
well-funded capital sources and private decision makers that that creates surety of execution. Our
firm provides second-to-none, extraordinary personal service along with incredible attention to
detail. Consequently, experienced deal makers clearly recognize that employing our firm provides
them with a tangible and definitive advantage. Not to mention, we have an incredibly high closure
rate!

We urge you to make Assets America^{®} part of your focused, diligent, commercial loan and
commercial transactional team. Submit your commercial loan request by clicking on the appropriate
line of business on this web page ([Multifamily][71], [Commercial][72], [Construction][73], [Private
Money or Mergers & Acquisitions][74]) or simply call us at the above phone number(s) to receive a
timely and highly insightful response.

## PERMANENT DEBT FINANCING – COMMERCIAL LOANS

In addition to permanent debt financing (commercial loans), we are able to structure transactions
using numerous types of loans. These include:
* [Commercial mortgage bridge loans][75]
* [High-leverage mezzanine debt][76]
* [Construction loans][77]
* [Straight equity][78]

Since we are not limited by our affiliation with any one capital source, we are able to present the
requested commercial loan financing to a broad spectrum of capital sources. This allows us to secure
the best transactional specific terms and pricing the market can offer. We save our clients time and
money by creating a competitive environment. Thus forcing the market to compete for the proposed
commercial loan financing. And, we have the experience and the insight to collaboratively determine
the best options. Ultimately, clients reap all the financial benefits of a superbly managed,
effective, and highly professional transaction.

## OUR SERVICES
## INCLUDE

But are not limited to, transaction evaluation, loan origination, deal structuring, document
processing, commercial loan financing request underwriting, electronic document management and
storage, sophisticated package organization and preparation, commercial loan placement submission,
term sheet negotiation, further coordinated underwriting, third party report coordination, loan
commitment negotiation, loan document review, and coordination of loan document signing, funding,
recording and closing. We can also assist in advising, coordinating, and guiding mid-market [Mergers
and Acquisitions (M&A) transactions][79] across multiple industries.

## COMMERCIAL REAL ESTATE &
## OTHER ASSET CLASSES

Commercial real estate owners (and other asset classes as well) select Assets America® for their
transactional and commercial loan financing needs. And, they know they are engaging a firm that
possesses the knowledge, the credibility, and the long-term, sophisticated relationships with
well-funded capital sources and private decision makers that that creates surety of execution. Our
firm provides second-to-none, extraordinary personal service along with incredible attention to
detail. Consequently, experienced deal makers clearly recognize that employing our firm provides
them with a tangible and definitive advantage. Not to mention, we have an incredibly high closure
rate!

We urge you to make Assets America^{®} part of your focused, diligent, commercial loan and
commercial transactional team. Submit your commercial loan request by clicking on the appropriate
line of business on this web page ([Multifamily][71], [Commercial][72], [Construction][73], [Private
Money or Mergers & Acquisitions][74]) or simply call us at the above phone number(s) to receive a
timely and highly insightful response.

## PERMANENT DEBT FINANCING – COMMERCIAL LOANS

In addition to permanent debt financing (commercial loans), we are able to structure transactions
using numerous types of loans. These include:
* [Commercial mortgage bridge loans][75]
* [High-leverage mezzanine debt][76]
* [Construction loans][77]
* [Straight equity][78]

Since we are not limited by our affiliation with any one capital source, we are able to present the
requested commercial loan financing to a broad spectrum of capital sources. This allows us to secure
the best transactional specific terms and pricing the market can offer. We save our clients time and
money by creating a competitive environment. Thus forcing the market to compete for the proposed
commercial loan financing. And, we have the experience and the insight to collaboratively determine
the best options. Ultimately, clients reap all the financial benefits of a superbly managed,
effective, and highly professional transaction.

## OUR SERVICES
## INCLUDE

But are not limited to, transaction evaluation, loan origination, deal structuring, document
processing, commercial loan financing request underwriting, electronic document management and
storage, sophisticated package organization and preparation, commercial loan placement submission,
term sheet negotiation, further coordinated underwriting, third party report coordination, loan
commitment negotiation, loan document review, and coordination of loan document signing, funding,
recording and closing. We can also assist in advising, coordinating, and guiding mid-market [Mergers
and Acquisitions (M&A) transactions][79] across multiple industries.

### Discover the Value of Expertise and Service at Aviation Laboratories.

Aviation Laboratories is the leading provider of aviation-specific testing, and the procurement and
distribution of chemical and maintenance products, for the aviation industry. We help MROs,
mechanics, and owners maintain and optimize aircraft performance, ensuring safe and efficient
operations in the aviation industry.

Our commitment to customer satisfaction and overall experience makes us a pillar in the aviation
community.

[ Read more ][43]
[Close-up of a jet engine turbine inside an industrial workshop.]

> We take pride in our knowledge of engine types and their common wear anomalies related to engine
> wear. We maintain strong, positive relationships with engine and oil manufacturers to keep up with
> the latest technical information. When customers choose us, they can rely on our expertise to
> deliver the most accurate results, backed by decades of data and experience. We don’t test cars,
> trucks, or boats. We’re an aviation ONLY laboratory service company and we specialize in Aircraft
> engine wear.

I take this opportunity to acknowledge the contribution of Avdel India Pvt Ltd. to ISRO's mission
and look forward to your continued support for all your future space endeavors.

**Dr. K. Sivan**

## BBGA Networking Event held at the House of Common

## Waitlist Only

The Reception brings together our members and business colleagues from overseas who have gathered at
Farnborough for the Air Show. 

[ View the Event Website and Access Ticket Bookings Here ][135]

The event also provides an opportunity to meet with members and industry colleagues who support and
help us in our endeavour to make General Aviation work for the economy of this country and Europe.

Drinks and Canapes are provided.  Dress: Business Attire

## BBGA/Universal Aviation Golf Tournament 2026

Enjoy bacon rolls and coffee on arrival, followed by 18 holes of championship golf. The package also
includes a complimentary drink from the club bar, a two‑course dinner, and the Universal Aviation
Prize Presentation to celebrate our winner

[ View the Event Website and Access Ticket Bookings Here ][136]

## ASA100, FAA AC 00-56B Certified Aircraft Part Inventory & Supply Chain Solutions Provider

[About Belair AERO]

## Company Profile

Belair AERO is India's only aircraft parts Inventory & Supply Chain solutions provider and we take
immense pride in being the country's first and only **FAA AC 00-56B** accredited parts supplier.

With a strong global presence, we cater to a diverse clientele in the aviation industry, providing
comprehensive solutions for their airframe and engine needs. Our commitment to excellence,
reliability, and customer satisfaction is ingrained in our company's DNA.

Airframes Engines

### ✈ Airframe Coverage
* **Manufacturers:** Airbus, Boeing, McDonnell Douglas, Bombardier, Embraer, ATR, De Havilland
  Canada
* **Airbus:** A320 Family, A330, A340, A350
* **Boeing:** 737 Family (CL & NG), 747, 757, 767, 777, 787
* **Other:** MD80, CRJ100-900, E170-E190, ATR42-72, DHC-6, DHC-8
* Covers regional and business jet aircraft

### ⚙ Engine Coverage
* **Manufacturers:** GE, CFM, P&W, Rolls-Royce, IAE, Honeywell Aerospace, Hamilton Sundstrand
* **GE / CFM:** CF680, GE90, CF34, CFM56-3/5/7
* **Pratt & Whitney:** PW2000, PW4000, PW 120 Series, PW 150 Series
* **Rolls-Royce / IAE:** RB211, Trent 700, Trent 800, V2500
* Regional and business jet engine expertise

## Our Services

Inventory designed around you

### Sales

Offering quality inventory with quality tags, at some of the most competitive prices in the
marketplace. We hold thousands of lines of inventory, from the mainstream to the hard-to-find. Our

# Discover The Cirrus Life

## Introducing the G3 Vision Jet

Cirrus proudly introduces its next achievement – the G3 Vision Jet, pushing the boundaries of
Personal Aviation, refined for even greater capability and amenities. The history-making,
best-selling turbine jet unlocks your time, productivity and options. The possibilities are yours to
discover.
[ Learn More ][43]
[G3_logo_neon3]

## Aircraft

[

### Vision Jet

#### Vision Jet
#### The Next Evolution is Here

The award-winning Vision Jet ushers in a new era in personal transportation where jet speed, jet
comfort and jet convenience are accessible.

][44]
[

### SR Series

#### SR Series | Everything In Reach

The SR Series G7+ aircraft is the first piston aircraft with Safe Return™ Emergency Autoland. The SR
Series also features features Perspective Touch+ by Garmin avionics, automatic database updates and
luxury details.

][45]

## SR SERIES G7+

The SR Series G7+ aircraft is the first piston aircraft with Safe Return™ Emergency Autoland. It
also includes new avionics features, expanded Cirrus Global Connect capabilities, refreshed design
collections and colors, and a 4-blade composite propeller upgrade option for the SR22.
[ SR Series ][46]
[Untitled-4 (2)]


[

## Instrument Rating Program

The Cirrus Instrument Rating Program, designed by Cirrus flight training experts, combines on-demand
learning with personalized in-aircraft instruction. Earn your instrument rating in a Cirrus SR
Series, expand your skillset and fly with confidence.
][47]
[

## Cirrus Approach App

The Cirrus Approach app, exclusively available on iPad, has been reimagined to include an Augmented
Reality (AR) pre-flight tool, featuring a lifelike, hands-on experience designed for the SR Series.
][48]


## Configure Your Cirrus Aircraft

[ Start Now ][49]
Cirrus Approach

## Flight Training

We want you to fly with the maximum level of skill and safety. That’s why we created Cirrus
Approach™ – a comprehensive training program with your lifestyle in mind. Explore courses like the
Private Pilot Program, Take-Offs and Landings and more.
[ Learn More ][50]
[Student with instructor in front of SR Series aircraft]
Aircraft Maintenance

## Service & Support

Our global network of Factory Direct and Authorized Service Centers feature trained technicians with
access to genuine parts and the latest procedures to maintain your aircraft to the highest standards
for the many years of flying adventures ahead.
[ Learn More ][51]
[man preflighting vision jet with ipad]
[

## Global Coverage

Our global network includes 700+ Cirrus Training Partners and Authorized Service Centers across the
world available to help, anywhere you fly.
][52] [

## How to Get Started

Discover how personal aviation can transform your life. Whether you’re new to flying or a seasoned
pilot, our team can help you begin your journey.

# Discover The Cirrus Life

## Introducing the G3 Vision Jet

Cirrus proudly introduces its next achievement – the G3 Vision Jet, pushing the boundaries of
Personal Aviation, refined for even greater capability and amenities. The history-making,
best-selling turbine jet unlocks your time, productivity and options. The possibilities are yours to
discover.
[ Learn More ][43]
[G3_logo_neon3]

## Aircraft

[

### Vision Jet

#### Vision Jet
#### The Next Evolution is Here

The award-winning Vision Jet ushers in a new era in personal transportation where jet speed, jet
comfort and jet convenience are accessible.

][44]
[

### SR Series

#### SR Series | Everything In Reach

The SR Series G7+ aircraft is the first piston aircraft with Safe Return™ Emergency Autoland. The SR
Series also features features Perspective Touch+ by Garmin avionics, automatic database updates and
luxury details.

][45]

## SR SERIES G7+

The SR Series G7+ aircraft is the first piston aircraft with Safe Return™ Emergency Autoland. It
also includes new avionics features, expanded Cirrus Global Connect capabilities, refreshed design
collections and colors, and a 4-blade composite propeller upgrade option for the SR22.
[ SR Series ][46]
[Untitled-4 (2)]


[

## Instrument Rating Program

The Cirrus Instrument Rating Program, designed by Cirrus flight training experts, combines on-demand
learning with personalized in-aircraft instruction. Earn your instrument rating in a Cirrus SR
Series, expand your skillset and fly with confidence.
][47]
[

## Cirrus Approach App

The Cirrus Approach app, exclusively available on iPad, has been reimagined to include an Augmented
Reality (AR) pre-flight tool, featuring a lifelike, hands-on experience designed for the SR Series.
][48]


## Configure Your Cirrus Aircraft

[ Start Now ][49]
Cirrus Approach

## Flight Training

We want you to fly with the maximum level of skill and safety. That’s why we created Cirrus
Approach™ – a comprehensive training program with your lifestyle in mind. Explore courses like the
Private Pilot Program, Take-Offs and Landings and more.
[ Learn More ][50]
[Student with instructor in front of SR Series aircraft]
Aircraft Maintenance

## Service & Support

Our global network of Factory Direct and Authorized Service Centers feature trained technicians with
access to genuine parts and the latest procedures to maintain your aircraft to the highest standards
for the many years of flying adventures ahead.
[ Learn More ][51]
[man preflighting vision jet with ipad]
[

## Global Coverage

Our global network includes 700+ Cirrus Training Partners and Authorized Service Centers across the
world available to help, anywhere you fly.
][52] [

## How to Get Started

Discover how personal aviation can transform your life. Whether you’re new to flying or a seasoned
pilot, our team can help you begin your journey.
][53]

Dassault Aviation is a French aerospace company with proven dual expertise as a manufacturer of both
military aircraft and business jets.
Creator of more than 100 prototypes in the last century, with over 10,000 aircraft delivered to 90
countries.
Dassault Aviation’s primary social responsibility (CSR) is to serve French national sovereignty, a
vital precondition for achieving sustainability goals.

## Dash 8-400

## Dash 8-400

Building on the success and popularity of the Dash 8-100/200/300 aircraft, the Dash 8-400 entered
into service with significant enhancements including new engines, a modernized cockpit, and improved
aerodynamics.

[Learn More][44]

## De Havilland Canadair 515

## De Havilland Canadair 515

Building on the exceptional operational capability of the CL-415, the next generation De Havilland
Canadair 515 offers significant benefits to operators, including design changes, Avionics Upgrade
Program, and De Havilland Canada’s global support network.

[Learn More][45]
[De Havilland Canada DHC-6 Twin Otter Classic 300-G Aircraft]

## Twin Otter Classic 300-G

For over 50 years, the DHC-6 Twin Otter has stood alone as the most reliable and versatile aircraft
in its class. After extensive consultation with customers, De Havilland Canada is poised and proud
to take this iconic aircraft to new heights with the new DHC-6 Twin Otter® Classic 300-G™.

[About us][26]

At Deutsche Aircraft, we push the boundaries of technological innovation by leading the way towards
carbon neutral flights.

[History Icon]
History empowering
innovation

We are the only German manufacturer of regional commercial aircraft, built on the pioneering
heritage of Dornier and Germany’s reputation for precision engineering and innovation.

[Sustainable icon]
Sustainable
regional connections

Exceptional operational flexibility enables our D328eco to handle the most challenging environments
and open up new routes to connect businesses and people.

[Diamond icon]

Fuelled by passion, our international team of highly qualified engineers, aviation experts and
senior management appointments from top-tier OEMs is committed to accelerating the transition toward
carbon neutral flights.

# **Specialty Fastener Suppliers**

When America’s engineers and mechanics need specialty fasteners to complete their projects, they
trust Dialogic Fasteners to deliver.  That’s why we’re the leading fasteners distributor in the
entire world.  Our reputation has made us the fastener specialties distributor of choice for the
military, aviation, and aerospace industries.  When your project requires specialty fasteners
manufactured to the tightest tolerances, we can provide industrial fasteners, hi-torque fasteners,
support fasteners, and more that will stand up to the punishing duty cycles of military hardware and
aerospace vehicles. Whether we’re acting as a fastener specialties distributor for civilian plane
manufacturers we always hold ourselves to the highest standards of quality.  You can count on
Dialogic to be your specialty fasteners distributor for projects on the land, in the sky, and
beyond.

We understand that our nation’s engineers and mechanics are under intense pressure to complete their
projects on time and on budget.  Dialogic is the specialty fasteners company that has the resources
it takes to make that happen.  For more than thirty years, both private businesses and government
contractors have relied on us when they need a special fasteners distributor who can get the job
done every time. No matter what type of project you’re working on, we want to be your go-to fastener
distribution company. We even are now focusing on supplying [**fasteners for medical
suppliers**][18].

## **Best Fastener Distribution Company**

Dialogic is the **[mil spec fastener][29]** distributor with the advantage.  Over our three decades
in business, we’ve served the U.S. Military and civilian engineers with great pride.  We’re the
company that has supplied the industrial fasteners, hi torque fasteners, support fasteners, and more
that have kept America’s Armed Forces up and running around the world.  Thanks to the massive size
of our stock, civilian engineers and military mechanics alike know that there’s only one specialty
fastener distribution company they need to call.  Just ask any of our satisfied customers; they’ll
tell you that Dialogic is the only aerospace fastener distributor to work with.

Not only are we a top-notch aerospace rivet distributor for the U.S. Military, we’re also a fastener
specialties distributor for the civilian aerospace industry.  Whether they’re designing Earth-based
vehicles or those that make their home beyond our planet, military and civilian engineers require a
wide selection of rivets and aerospace fasteners.  As the world’s premiere aerospace fastener
distributor, these industry professionals come to us for all their hard-to-find components like
industrial fasteners and hi torque fasteners.  Are you working on safe and reliable civilian
aircraft?  We’re the leading aerospace rivet distributor in the world.  Are you an engineer
designing spacecraft that will bring the final frontier closer than ever before?  We’re the
fasteners distributor and suppliers you want to get in touch with.  From terrestrial vehicles to
satellites and space planes, we’re the **[aero fastener distributor][30]** with the fastener
specialties list of your dreams.

## **Specialty Wholesale Fasteners**

Do you have a difficult list of specialty fasteners that you can’t seem to find in the usual
stores?  Don’t waste your valuable time looking at other suppliers; seek out Dialogic Fasteners
right away.  As a fastener specialties distributor with thirty years of experience, you can rest
assured you’ll find the parts you’re looking for in our extensive database.  We’ve organized
millions of unique parts, meaning we’ll always have everything you need to complete your project on
time and on budget.  We’re even a fasteners distributor that can customize your parts to meet a
specific need, so be sure to ask about our parts customization when placing your order.

When we tell you that we’re the best fastener specialties suppliers in the world, you don’t have to
take our word for it.  We are an approved aero fastener distributor, a milestone achievement
reserved for only for top-tier companies who consistently demonstrate an unwavering commitment to
quality and outstanding service.  In short, we’re an aerospace rivet distributor that can be trusted
even with the most sensitive projects.  We’re the **[aircraft parts distributors][31]** with the
knowledge and background to make every order a successful one for you. 

Are you looking for an outdated screw for a military vehicle?  We’re the mil spec fastener
distributor that carries parts specifications dating as far back as World War II.  Working on a
totally custom project?  We’re the fastener distribution company that can modify or machine one-off
custom parts for any application.  Need an aerospace fastener distributor for space project?  We’ve
been the aero fastener distributor of choice for DLA and the U.S. Military for decades.  Over that
time, we’ve worked hard to become better and better every year; now we want to be the specialty
fastener distribution suppliers you turn to for those rare parts.

Logistics are a big part of the fastener distribution industry.  Shipments must be on time, or
there’s a chance you won’t be able to complete your project.  It takes the cooperation of an entire
team to ensure fastener distribution goes according to plan.  At Dialogic Fasteners, we’re experts
in the logistics of being an aerospace fastener distributor for 2020 and beyond.  We have been
approved by the Defense Industrial Supply Center in Philadelphia as a QML/QSLM supplier of quality
material, and we take that seriously as a mil spec fastener distributor.  This coveted qualification
points to us being the aero fastener distributor that is focused on the future, whether it’s here on
Earth or out in space.

If you’re looking for precision-engineered aerospace parts, you should know we’re the best suppliers
of mil spec fasteners in the United States or anywhere else.  We serve private companies, the Air
Force, the Army, and more.  Get in touch with us by dialing [**(215) 245-7373**][32], by sending an
email to **[sales@dialogic-fasteners.com][33]**, or by filling out the online form on our contact
page.  Don’t forget to ask about our custom coatings and machining services when you order.

## **Best Fastener Distribution Company**

Dialogic is the **[mil spec fastener][29]** distributor with the advantage.  Over our three decades
in business, we’ve served the U.S. Military and civilian engineers with great pride.  We’re the
company that has supplied the industrial fasteners, hi torque fasteners, support fasteners, and more
that have kept America’s Armed Forces up and running around the world.  Thanks to the massive size
of our stock, civilian engineers and military mechanics alike know that there’s only one specialty
fastener distribution company they need to call.  Just ask any of our satisfied customers; they’ll
tell you that Dialogic is the only aerospace fastener distributor to work with.

Not only are we a top-notch aerospace rivet distributor for the U.S. Military, we’re also a fastener
specialties distributor for the civilian aerospace industry.  Whether they’re designing Earth-based
vehicles or those that make their home beyond our planet, military and civilian engineers require a
wide selection of rivets and aerospace fasteners.  As the world’s premiere aerospace fastener
distributor, these industry professionals come to us for all their hard-to-find components like
industrial fasteners and hi torque fasteners.  Are you working on safe and reliable civilian
aircraft?  We’re the leading aerospace rivet distributor in the world.  Are you an engineer
designing spacecraft that will bring the final frontier closer than ever before?  We’re the
fasteners distributor and suppliers you want to get in touch with.  From terrestrial vehicles to
satellites and space planes, we’re the **[aero fastener distributor][30]** with the fastener
specialties list of your dreams.

## **Specialty Wholesale Fasteners**

Do you have a difficult list of specialty fasteners that you can’t seem to find in the usual
stores?  Don’t waste your valuable time looking at other suppliers; seek out Dialogic Fasteners
right away.  As a fastener specialties distributor with thirty years of experience, you can rest
assured you’ll find the parts you’re looking for in our extensive database.  We’ve organized
millions of unique parts, meaning we’ll always have everything you need to complete your project on
time and on budget.  We’re even a fasteners distributor that can customize your parts to meet a
specific need, so be sure to ask about our parts customization when placing your order.

When we tell you that we’re the best fastener specialties suppliers in the world, you don’t have to
take our word for it.  We are an approved aero fastener distributor, a milestone achievement
reserved for only for top-tier companies who consistently demonstrate an unwavering commitment to
quality and outstanding service.  In short, we’re an aerospace rivet distributor that can be trusted
even with the most sensitive projects.  We’re the **[aircraft parts distributors][31]** with the
knowledge and background to make every order a successful one for you. 

Are you looking for an outdated screw for a military vehicle?  We’re the mil spec fastener
distributor that carries parts specifications dating as far back as World War II.  Working on a
totally custom project?  We’re the fastener distribution company that can modify or machine one-off
custom parts for any application.  Need an aerospace fastener distributor for space project?  We’ve
been the aero fastener distributor of choice for DLA and the U.S. Military for decades.  Over that
time, we’ve worked hard to become better and better every year; now we want to be the specialty
fastener distribution suppliers you turn to for those rare parts.

Logistics are a big part of the fastener distribution industry.  Shipments must be on time, or
there’s a chance you won’t be able to complete your project.  It takes the cooperation of an entire
team to ensure fastener distribution goes according to plan.  At Dialogic Fasteners, we’re experts
in the logistics of being an aerospace fastener distributor for 2020 and beyond.  We have been
approved by the Defense Industrial Supply Center in Philadelphia as a QML/QSLM supplier of quality
material, and we take that seriously as a mil spec fastener distributor.  This coveted qualification
points to us being the aero fastener distributor that is focused on the future, whether it’s here on
Earth or out in space.

If you’re looking for precision-engineered aerospace parts, you should know we’re the best suppliers
of mil spec fasteners in the United States or anywhere else.  We serve private companies, the Air
Force, the Army, and more.  Get in touch with us by dialing [**(215) 245-7373**][32], by sending an
email to **[sales@dialogic-fasteners.com][33]**, or by filling out the online form on our contact

# Build Time Fast. Elevate Your Career.

airline hiring minimums.

Why pilots choose Elemental

## Your next opportunity starts with your next hour.

The climb to 1,500 hours is the most expensive stretch of a pilot's career. Our program is built to
shorten it — with efficient aircraft, honest pricing, and scheduling that works around your goals,
whether you're airline-bound or simply building time toward your next rating.

### A lower cost per logged hour

Our modern aircraft burn a fraction of the fuel of legacy trainers. That efficiency goes straight
into your logbook — more hours for less.

### A faster route to 1,500

Block-rate flying and dependable aircraft availability let you build time on your timeline. Momentum
is the whole point.

### Aircraft built for the mission

Full glass Garmin avionics with autopilot and efficient Rotax engines — so you build simulated
instrument and TAA time in aircraft that stay ready to fly.

### Flying that fits your schedule

Straightforward booking and reliable dispatch. The hours you plan are the hours you fly.

How it works

## Three steps to the flight line.

Getting started is simple — no lengthy process, no guesswork.
1. 01
   
   ### Choose your block
   
   Pick the block of hours that fits your goal and your budget. Transparent rates, nothing hidden.
2. 02
   
   ### Fly modern aircraft
   
   Build time in efficient, well-maintained Pipistrel Alpha Trainers at Spanish Fork Airport (KSPK).
3. 03
   
   ### Reach your minimums
   
   Log the hours that move you toward 1,500 — and the airline hiring line.

[See Program & Pricing][22]

Why it beats instructing

## The fastest path to the right seat.

Every month you spend instructing to reach 1,500 is a month you're *not* earning an airline paycheck
or building seniority. Block-rate flying compresses the years into months.

Instructing

The slow way around
* 18–24 months to reach 1,500 — you only fly when students book
* Your progress is capped by the school's schedule, aircraft availability, and student load
* Requires a CFI certificate
* Modest instructor pay that's a fraction of an airline salary
* Every extra month is lost airline seniority and lost earnings

Block-rate flying with Elemental

The fast track
* Reach 1,500 in as little as ~7 months — fly up to 8 hours a day, 6 days a week
* Your schedule and aircraft you can count on being available
* No CFI required
* Modern Garmin glass
* Reach the airlines sooner: start airline pay and seniority years earlier

### Time to 1,500 — and the airline pay it unlocks

Both paths start from a commercial certificate at **250 hours**. Flying up to 8 hours a day, six
days a week (~208 hrs/month), an EPD cadet reaches the 1,500-hour ATP minimum in about **6 months**
— versus roughly **18 months** instructing at a typical 60–80 hrs/month. The airline-pay lines start
the month each pilot hits 1,500 and can move to a 121 first-officer seat.

≈ $100,000 head start — the airline pay an EPD cadet banks before an instructor even reaches 1,500
hours.

Both pilots start at a 250-hour commercial certificate. Assumes an EPD cadet flying ~208 hrs/month
and a CFI building ~70 hrs/month; instructor pace varies widely by school and student load. Airline
pay assumes a 121 regional first-officer salary of $100,000/year ($8,333/month), counted from the
month each pilot reaches 1,500 hours. Because instructing takes roughly a year longer to reach ATP
minimums, that's about **a full year of first-officer pay that never gets recovered**, and the
instructor starts building airline seniority a year later, which compounds over a career.

Program & pricing

## Transparent block rates. Buy more, fly for less.

Our goal is the most affordable time building anywhere — so we schedule dual-occupancy whenever we
can, letting two pilots share the aircraft and split the cost. The rates below are per pilot, dual
occupancy; solo rates are listed too. Every rate is published up front, and the larger your block,
the lower your cost per hour.

25 Hours

$87.50/hr

per pilot · dual occupancy

[A Pipistrel Alpha Trainer in flight over a Utah lake]

The fleet

## Modern aircraft. Remarkable efficiency.

We fly a fleet of 2023-or-newer Pipistrel Alpha Trainers equipped with full glass Garmin avionics
and autopilot, powered by the efficient Rotax 912UL engine. You'll build affordable time while
logging simulated instrument and TAA experience, at roughly three gallons an hour. Every aircraft
also carries a full-airframe Ballistic Parachute Rescue System (BPRS) for an added margin of safety.
And because we own and maintain our fleet, the aircraft you book are the aircraft that fly.

[Explore the Fleet][28]

The flight deck

### A full glass Garmin panel.

Build simulated instrument and TAA time behind a modern Garmin flight deck with autopilot — the same
avionics family you'll fly in the airlines.
* 10″ Garmin G3X Touch Primary flight display
* Garmin GMC 507 Autopilot
* Garmin GNX 375 GPS navigator + ADS-B transponder
* Garmin G5 Standby flight instrument
* Garmin GNC 215 NAV/COM radio
* Garmin GTR 205 COM radio

[The Pipistrel Alpha Trainer glass cockpit: a 10-inch Garmin G3X Touch display, autopilot, and
Garmin radios]
Coming 2027

We're adding a **multi-engine twin** to the fleet — so you can build multi-engine time with us and
become a more competitive airline candidate.

Straight talk

## The hours you'll build — and what they count for.

### Build it here
* Build total, PIC, cross-country, and night flight time.*
* Simulated instrument under the hood with a safety pilot — logged by both pilots under dual
  occupancy
* TAA time in a full Garmin glass panel with autopilot
* Multi-engine and complex time — with the addition of a multi-engine twin to the fleet in 2027

*Scheduling priority for night flying is given to pilots with fewer than 100 hours of total night
time.

Bottom line: build your total, PIC, cross-country, night, TAA, and simulated instrument time
efficiently and affordably — then add multi-engine and complex time with us when our twin joins the
fleet in 2027. Not sure how your hours add up to your goal? [Ask us and we'll map it out.][29]

Your path

## See the runway to the airlines.

Every pilot's timeline is a little different, but the destination is the same. Here's where
Elemental fits in.
1. 01
   
   ### Commercial certificate
   
   You've earned your commercial ticket. Now the clock starts on building time.
2. 02
   
   ### Build time with Elemental
   
   Efficient, affordable hours that add up fast — the stretch where most pilots lose time and money,
   and where we help most.
3. 03
   
   ### Reach 1,500 / ATP
   
   Cross the FAA's airline threshold with the hours and experience recruiters look for.
4. 04
   
   ### Airline hiring
   
   Apply to the regionals and beyond — on schedule and on budget.

About Elemental

## A serious program for pilots with a destination.

Elemental was built by people who know aviation from the inside. We own our aircraft, maintain them
ourselves, and price our program so building time is finally within reach. No inflated rates, no
aging fleet, no runaround — just an efficient, professional way to build the time your career needs.
We're built to accelerate the airline path, but the program is open to every pilot building time,
whatever your destination.
* Transparent, block-rate pricing
* A modern fleet we own and maintain
* Efficiency that lowers your cost per hour
* A program built around the airline hiring path
* A team that treats your career like it matters

Why pilots choose Elemental

## Your next opportunity starts with your next hour.

The climb to 1,500 hours is the most expensive stretch of a pilot's career. Our program is built to
shorten it — with efficient aircraft, honest pricing, and scheduling that works around your goals,
whether you're airline-bound or simply building time toward your next rating.

### A lower cost per logged hour

Our modern aircraft burn a fraction of the fuel of legacy trainers. That efficiency goes straight
into your logbook — more hours for less.

### A faster route to 1,500

Block-rate flying and dependable aircraft availability let you build time on your timeline. Momentum
is the whole point.

### Aircraft built for the mission

Full glass Garmin avionics with autopilot and efficient Rotax engines — so you build simulated
instrument and TAA time in aircraft that stay ready to fly.

### Flying that fits your schedule

Straightforward booking and reliable dispatch. The hours you plan are the hours you fly.

How it works

## Three steps to the flight line.

Getting started is simple — no lengthy process, no guesswork.
1. 01
   
   ### Choose your block
   
   Pick the block of hours that fits your goal and your budget. Transparent rates, nothing hidden.
2. 02
   
   ### Fly modern aircraft
   
   Build time in efficient, well-maintained Pipistrel Alpha Trainers at Spanish Fork Airport (KSPK).
3. 03
   
   ### Reach your minimums
   
   Log the hours that move you toward 1,500 — and the airline hiring line.

[See Program & Pricing][22]

Why it beats instructing

## The fastest path to the right seat.

Every month you spend instructing to reach 1,500 is a month you're *not* earning an airline paycheck
or building seniority. Block-rate flying compresses the years into months.

Instructing

The slow way around
* 18–24 months to reach 1,500 — you only fly when students book
* Your progress is capped by the school's schedule, aircraft availability, and student load
* Requires a CFI certificate
* Modest instructor pay that's a fraction of an airline salary
* Every extra month is lost airline seniority and lost earnings

Block-rate flying with Elemental

The fast track
* Reach 1,500 in as little as ~7 months — fly up to 8 hours a day, 6 days a week
* Your schedule and aircraft you can count on being available
* No CFI required
* Modern Garmin glass
* Reach the airlines sooner: start airline pay and seniority years earlier

### Time to 1,500 — and the airline pay it unlocks

Both paths start from a commercial certificate at **250 hours**. Flying up to 8 hours a day, six
days a week (~208 hrs/month), an EPD cadet reaches the 1,500-hour ATP minimum in about **6 months**
— versus roughly **18 months** instructing at a typical 60–80 hrs/month. The airline-pay lines start
the month each pilot hits 1,500 and can move to a 121 first-officer seat.

≈ $100,000 head start — the airline pay an EPD cadet banks before an instructor even reaches 1,500
hours.

Both pilots start at a 250-hour commercial certificate. Assumes an EPD cadet flying ~208 hrs/month
and a CFI building ~70 hrs/month; instructor pace varies widely by school and student load. Airline
pay assumes a 121 regional first-officer salary of $100,000/year ($8,333/month), counted from the
month each pilot reaches 1,500 hours. Because instructing takes roughly a year longer to reach ATP
minimums, that's about **a full year of first-officer pay that never gets recovered**, and the
instructor starts building airline seniority a year later, which compounds over a career.

The fleet

## Modern aircraft. Remarkable efficiency.

We fly a fleet of 2023-or-newer Pipistrel Alpha Trainers equipped with full glass Garmin avionics
and autopilot, powered by the efficient Rotax 912UL engine. You'll build affordable time while
logging simulated instrument and TAA experience, at roughly three gallons an hour. Every aircraft
also carries a full-airframe Ballistic Parachute Rescue System (BPRS) for an added margin of safety.
And because we own and maintain our fleet, the aircraft you book are the aircraft that fly.

[Explore the Fleet][28]

The flight deck

### A full glass Garmin panel.

Build simulated instrument and TAA time behind a modern Garmin flight deck with autopilot — the same
avionics family you'll fly in the airlines.
* 10″ Garmin G3X Touch Primary flight display
* Garmin GMC 507 Autopilot
* Garmin GNX 375 GPS navigator + ADS-B transponder
* Garmin G5 Standby flight instrument
* Garmin GNC 215 NAV/COM radio
* Garmin GTR 205 COM radio

[The Pipistrel Alpha Trainer glass cockpit: a 10-inch Garmin G3X Touch display, autopilot, and
Garmin radios]
Coming 2027

We're adding a **multi-engine twin** to the fleet — so you can build multi-engine time with us and
become a more competitive airline candidate.

Straight talk

## The hours you'll build — and what they count for.

### Build it here
* Build total, PIC, cross-country, and night flight time.*
* Simulated instrument under the hood with a safety pilot — logged by both pilots under dual
  occupancy
* TAA time in a full Garmin glass panel with autopilot
* Multi-engine and complex time — with the addition of a multi-engine twin to the fleet in 2027

*Scheduling priority for night flying is given to pilots with fewer than 100 hours of total night
time.

Bottom line: build your total, PIC, cross-country, night, TAA, and simulated instrument time
efficiently and affordably — then add multi-engine and complex time with us when our twin joins the
fleet in 2027. Not sure how your hours add up to your goal? [Ask us and we'll map it out.][29]

Your path

## See the runway to the airlines.

Every pilot's timeline is a little different, but the destination is the same. Here's where
Elemental fits in.
1. 01
   
   ### Commercial certificate
   
   You've earned your commercial ticket. Now the clock starts on building time.
2. 02
   
   ### Build time with Elemental
   
   Efficient, affordable hours that add up fast — the stretch where most pilots lose time and money,
   and where we help most.
3. 03
   
   ### Reach 1,500 / ATP
   
   Cross the FAA's airline threshold with the hours and experience recruiters look for.
4. 04
   
   ### Airline hiring
   
   Apply to the regionals and beyond — on schedule and on budget.

Elemental was built by people who know aviation from the inside. We own our aircraft, maintain them
ourselves, and price our program so building time is finally within reach. No inflated rates, no

We're built to accelerate the airline path, but the program is open to every pilot building time,

## A new Epic era has landed

Delivering the same unparalleled performance as its predecessor and category-leading E1000 *GX*, the
E1000 AX offers over 25 new features, including Garmin® Autothrottle and Autoland*, Garmin® GDL™ 60
with PlaneSync™ Technology for automatic database updates, CoolView windows, True Blue Power®
Intelligent Lithium-Ion Batteries, and Epic Direct® high-speed internet. The best single-engine
turboprop is now even better.

[ Explore the E1000 AX ][20]

*Activated Upon Final Certification

Why Fly an Epic?

Epic Customer

][23]
