**Wes B.**

Epic Customer

Join Us On Tour
It’s time to meet your next airplane. Discover the advanced automation and superior
safety, jet-class performance, and first-class cabin comfort of the E1000 AX — making this the
aircraft worth meeting.
[ Meet the E1000 AX on Tour ][24]

## Epic Flight Training

Train with the pilots who know the airplane best. Epic’s immersive training program is tailored to
your experience level and designed specifically for the Epic Aircraft fleet, equipping you with the
skill and confidence to fly at the highest standards.
[ Train to Fly an Epic ][25]

## Epic Safety Program™

Safety starts with design and continues through support, training and our company commitment. The
structured program brings together advanced systems, proven operational practices, and ongoing
education to support our number one priority: to keep our pilots, passengers and planes safe.

[ Learn About Our Commitment to Safety ][26]

## BRING YOUR CHALLENGES.

### WE’VE GOT THE SOLUTIONS.

No matter how many hours we’re in the air, the magic never fades. Nothing compares to the joy and
satisfaction of bursting free of gravity when we take to the sky. From day one, we have put our
passion for innovation and technology into finding ever-better solutions.

We have built – and continue to create – technology that pushes the boundaries of aircraft engine
performance to take the piloting experience to the next level.

The requirements for engines in aviation continue to evolve. They need to lower emissions, consume
less fuel, and make less noise while producing more power. These are challenges that inspire us as
we reach for the freedom of the sky.

# About GAMA

**The General Aviation Manufacturers Association (GAMA)** exists to foster and advance the general
welfare, safety, interests, and activities of the global business and general aviation industry.
This includes promoting a better understanding of general aviation manufacturing, maintenance,
repair, and overhaul and the important role these industry segments play in economic growth and
opportunity, and in serving the critical transportation needs of communities, companies, and
individuals worldwide.

[More About GAMA][53]

* In the U.S., General Aviation flies over **28.6 million hours**, of which two-thirds are for

The Phenom 300EV, the latest evolution of [Embraer][72]'s best-selling light jet, introduces a range
of safety, performance, and cabin enhancements. The aircraft becomes the largest business jet
equipped with Garmin Emergency Autoland, while also adding a class-exclusive autobrake system, an
Embraer-developed electronic controller with rudder-by-wire capability, and upgraded Garmin avionics
to improve pilot awareness and reduce workload. Performance has also been boosted with an extended
range of 2,055 nautical miles and an additional 430 pounds of payload capacity, alongside new
lithium-ion batteries and LED lighting. The cabin gains worldwide LEO satellite connectivity, an

## [ 2026 State of the Industry Press Conference ][52]

GAMA's 2026 State of the Industry press conference, took place on February 18, 2026. During the

# About GAMA

**The General Aviation Manufacturers Association (GAMA)** exists to foster and advance the general
welfare, safety, interests, and activities of the global business and general aviation industry.
This includes promoting a better understanding of general aviation manufacturing, maintenance,
repair, and overhaul and the important role these industry segments play in economic growth and
opportunity, and in serving the critical transportation needs of communities, companies, and
individuals worldwide.

Avionics maker [Avidyne][64] has expanded the capabilities of its Vantage 12 integrated flight
display system for legacy Cirrus aircraft by adding broader compatibility and a new digital
autopilot option. The latest enhancements are designed to make the upgrade more attractive for
owners of older Cirrus SR20 and SR22 aircraft while simplifying the transition from earlier Entegra
avionics.The Vantage 12 system features dual 12-inch touchscreen displays, 3D Synthetic Vision, full
display redundancy, and a combination of touchscreen and physical controls. It also introduces a new
autopilot offering designed to broaden the appeal of the Vantage 12 ecosystem. The expanded avionics
package is intended to give owners of older Cirrus aircraft access to a modern glass cockpit and
autopilot solution without requiring a complete panel replacement, reducing installation complexity
and aircraft downtime. ... [See MoreSee Less][65]

The Phenom 300EV, the latest evolution of [Embraer][72]'s best-selling light jet, introduces a range
of safety, performance, and cabin enhancements. The aircraft becomes the largest business jet
equipped with Garmin Emergency Autoland, while also adding a class-exclusive autobrake system, an
Embraer-developed electronic controller with rudder-by-wire capability, and upgraded Garmin avionics
to improve pilot awareness and reduce workload. Performance has also been boosted with an extended
range of 2,055 nautical miles and an additional 430 pounds of payload capacity, alongside new
lithium-ion batteries and LED lighting. The cabin gains worldwide LEO satellite connectivity, an
upgraded refreshment center, improved climate control, an odorless vacuum lavatory, and an air
ionization system. Deliveries of the Phenom 300EV are expected to begin in 2028. ... [See MoreSee

## Two market-leading aerospace divisions

[GTF Engine at Paris Airshow 2019 Static Display30]

### Engines

Our industry-leading Engines division is a trusted technology partner to all global engine
manufacturers, offering differentiated aero-engine products, processes and IP. GKN Aerospace is
uniquely positioned for next-generation platforms. Its exceptional portfolio of engine partnerships
is entering the attractive aftermarket phase served by its fast-growing repair business.

[ Find more about Engines ][73]

#### Customers

Engines OEMs

#### Technology

High performance structural and rotating engine components; parts repair; High speed machining,
Composite technologies, Laser Welding and Additive Fabrication, Electric and Hydrogen Propulsion

#### End market

Aerospace industry, including commercial aviation industry and military aviation industry. The
after-market includes airlines. The end market also encompasses the space industry

#### 2025 revenue

*£1.6bn*

#### Employees

*4,000*

#### Manufacturing sites

*11*
[A350 XWB Airbus]

### Airframes

Our design-led Airframes division offers structures technology, electrical distribution systems,
transparencies, and ice-protection systems from a global industrial footprint. It has embedded
customer positions on all today’s major aircraft, and its superior technology means it is well
placed for the next-generation across both the civil and defence markets.

[ Find more about Aerostructures ][74]

#### Customers

Airframe OEMs

#### Technology

Lightweight composite and metallic structures; electrical distribution systems; landing gear
components High-speed Machining, Metal bonding, Composite technologies, Additive Manufacturing,
Electric and Hydrogen Propulsion

#### End market

Aerospace industry, including commercial aviation, military aviation, business aviation and advanced
air mobility

#### 2025 revenue

*£2bn*

#### Employees

*12,000*

#### Manufacturing Sites

*21*

##### With 32 manufacturing locations in 12 countries, we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and

##### aerostructures and engine systems. Our unrivalled products, systems, and services are integral

## GKN Aerospace global capabilities

[GKN Video Thumbnail] [ Play Video ][72]

## Two market-leading aerospace divisions

[GTF Engine at Paris Airshow 2019 Static Display30]

### Engines

Our industry-leading Engines division is a trusted technology partner to all global engine
manufacturers, offering differentiated aero-engine products, processes and IP. GKN Aerospace is
uniquely positioned for next-generation platforms. Its exceptional portfolio of engine partnerships
is entering the attractive aftermarket phase served by its fast-growing repair business.

[ Find more about Engines ][73]

#### Customers

Engines OEMs

#### Technology

High performance structural and rotating engine components; parts repair; High speed machining,
Composite technologies, Laser Welding and Additive Fabrication, Electric and Hydrogen Propulsion

#### End market

Aerospace industry, including commercial aviation industry and military aviation industry. The
after-market includes airlines. The end market also encompasses the space industry

#### 2025 revenue

*£1.6bn*

#### Employees

*4,000*

#### Manufacturing sites

*11*
[A350 XWB Airbus]

### Airframes

Our design-led Airframes division offers structures technology, electrical distribution systems,
transparencies, and ice-protection systems from a global industrial footprint. It has embedded
customer positions on all today’s major aircraft, and its superior technology means it is well
placed for the next-generation across both the civil and defence markets.

[ Find more about Aerostructures ][74]

#### Customers

Airframe OEMs

#### Technology

Lightweight composite and metallic structures; electrical distribution systems; landing gear
components High-speed Machining, Metal bonding, Composite technologies, Additive Manufacturing,
Electric and Hydrogen Propulsion

#### End market

Aerospace industry, including commercial aviation, military aviation, business aviation and advanced
air mobility

#### 2025 revenue

*£2bn*

#### Employees

*12,000*

#### Manufacturing Sites

*21*

## Technology

GKN Aerospace is the original aerospace innovator, with more than 265 years of industrial heritage
and a century as aviation pioneers.

[ Explore innovation ][79]
[48 Pax KP (3)Latest]

## Sustainability

Committed to doing the right thing. Our approach to sustainability can be summed up in one phrase:
doing the right thing – by our people, our planet, and our technology. This means acting in a safe,
ethical manner in everything we do.

[ Explore sustainability ][80]

## Markets

[Home Banner Engines 1600X800]

### Engines

If you’ve ever flown anywhere, chances are we’ve already met. Surely, you’ve seen the large turbines
hanging beneath the aircraft’s wings. Those are the engines – and that’s our business.

[ Find out more ][81]
[Hero Banner Civil 1600X800]

### Civil

We provide wing structures, fuselages, empennages, transparencies, electrical wiring systems and
components for major platforms ranging from helicopters to business jets to the most used single
aisle aircraft and most advanced eVTOLs in the world.

[ Find out more ][82]
[Hero Banner Defense 1600X800]

### Defence

At GKN Aerospace we shape the Future of Flight. With our innovative technologies and our unique
global network, we provide our defence customers across the world with systems and components that
make aircraft fly faster and further.

[ Find out more ][83]
[Bristol Robot]

## Our differentiators

Why GKN Aerospace and what makes us unique. We look beyond immediate market requirements, assessing
the impact of environmental and technological trends on aviation and passengers.

[ Find out more ][84]

[Colleagues on shop floor in Hoogeveen 0563]

## Our locations

Today we are truly global, with 16,000 employees in 32 manufacturing locations in 12 countries
around the world.

We design and manufacture innovative smart aerospace systems and components.

# Willkommen bei Holmberg

Hochwertige Kommunikationslösungen für den professionellen Einsatz

[Willkommen bei Holmberg elektroakustische Lösungen für den professionellen Einsatz]

## News – KRYPTON II

Die neue Generation des **HOLM**CO-Headsets, das KRYPTON II, ist für den professionellen Einsatz in
Leitstellen und in anderen sicherheitskritischen Arbeitsumgebungen konzipiert. Das Headset überzeugt
durch höchsten Tragekomfort und exzellente Sprachverständlichkeit – auch bei langen Einsatzzeiten.

[MEHR ERFAHREN][33]

## Das Unternehmen auf einen Blick

**HOLM**CO wurde 1919 gegründet und befindet sich seit 1951 im Familienbesitz. Im Herzen Berlins
entwickeln und produzieren wir elektroakustische Geräte für den professionellen Einsatz unter
anspruchsvollen Bedingungen.

Unser bereits in dritter Generation inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen steht für Offenheit,
Vertrauen, Zuverlässigkeit, Loyalität, Fairness und kulturelle Vielfalt.

Bei **HOLM**CO entstehen unter Anwendung höchster Qualitätsstandards dynamische Schallwandler,
Mikrofone, Hörsprechgarnituren und Handapparate für den professionellen Einsatz. Unsere Kunden
kommen aus der Luftfahrt, ÖPNV und Bahntechnik, BOS, Leitstellentechnik sowie Defence.

[MEHR ERFAHREN][34]

### Elektroakustische Produkte

Unsere Produkte bieten höchste Sprachverständlichkeit und zuverlässige Kommunikation – insbesondere
unter anspruchsvollsten und rauen Einsatzbedingungen.

### Made in Germany

Von der Idee bis zum marktreifen Produkt : Alle Entwicklungs- und Produktionsschritte finden an
unserem Standort in Berlin statt.

### Mitarbeitende

200 Mitarbeitende sorgen dafür, dass unsere Kunden hochwertige Produkte erhalten, die an ihre
Bedürfnisse angepasst sind.

### Höchste Qualität

Wir sind zertifiziert nach DIN EN ISO 9100 und sind genehmigter Herstellungs- sowie
Instandhaltungsbetrieb für Luftfahrtgeräte gemäß EASA.

### Nachhaltigkeit

Durch nachhaltige Lösungen und die fortlaufende Verbesserung unserer Prozesse stellen wir eine
effiziente und zukunftsorientierte Arbeitsweise sicher.

### Umweltmanagement

2019 habe wir ein Umweltmanagementsystem nach DIN EN ISO 14001 aufgebaut und sind seit 2021 bei der
Plattform EcoVadis registriert (EcoVadis Silver 2025).

## Innovation als Tradition

Von der analogen Technik bis ins digitale Zeitalter: Seit über einhundert Jahren steht die Marke
**HOLM**CO für die verlässliche Übertragung von Sprachsignalen zur Kommunikation in geräuschvoller
und rauer Umgebung.

Ob auf See, an Land oder in der Luft, überall sind Produkte von Holmberg zuverlässig im
professionellen Einsatz. Anforderungen und Technologien haben sich in den letzten Jahrzehnten rasant
verändert, ebenso wie das Umfeld, in dem sich der Mensch bewegt und kommuniziert.

Wir sind für die sichere Kommunikation unserer Kunden immer in Bewegung. Denn Innovation ist unsere
Tradition.

## Unsere Geschäftsfelder

### Luftfahrt

Ausgezeichnete Sprachverständlichkeit für Luft und Boden
[MEHR ERFAHREN][35]

### Verteidigung

Zuverlässige Kommunikation für Schutz und Verteidigung
[MEHR ERFAHREN][36]

### Schiff & Marine

Klare Kommunikation auch bei rauen Bedingungen auf See
[MEHR ERFAHREN][37]

### BOS

Im Einsatz sicher vernetzt
[MEHR ERFAHREN][38]

### ÖPNV & Bahn

Verlässliche Verbindung für Straße und Schiene
[MEHR ERFAHREN][39]

### Leitstellen

Präzise planen und schnell entscheiden
[MEHR ERFAHREN][40]

## Kontaktieren Sie uns jetzt

Die Anforderungen an unsere Produkte sind so unterschiedlich wie die Bereiche, in denen sie
eingesetzt werden.
Daher passen wir unsere Produkte an Ihre individuellen Bedürfnisse an und
entwickeln kundenspezifische Lösungen nach Maß.

[ANGEBOT EINHOLEN][41]

# Willkommen bei Holmberg

Hochwertige Kommunikationslösungen für den professionellen Einsatz
[ Luftfahrt ][27] [ Verteidigung ][28] [ Schiff & Marine ][29] [ BOS ][30] [ ÖPNV & Bahn ][31] [
Leitstellen ][32]
[Willkommen bei Holmberg elektroakustische Lösungen für den professionellen Einsatz]

## News – KRYPTON II

Die neue Generation des **HOLM**CO-Headsets, das KRYPTON II, ist für den professionellen Einsatz in
Leitstellen und in anderen sicherheitskritischen Arbeitsumgebungen konzipiert. Das Headset überzeugt
durch höchsten Tragekomfort und exzellente Sprachverständlichkeit – auch bei langen Einsatzzeiten.

[MEHR ERFAHREN][33]

## Das Unternehmen auf einen Blick

**HOLM**CO wurde 1919 gegründet und befindet sich seit 1951 im Familienbesitz. Im Herzen Berlins
entwickeln und produzieren wir elektroakustische Geräte für den professionellen Einsatz unter
anspruchsvollen Bedingungen.

Unser bereits in dritter Generation inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen steht für Offenheit,
Vertrauen, Zuverlässigkeit, Loyalität, Fairness und kulturelle Vielfalt.

Bei **HOLM**CO entstehen unter Anwendung höchster Qualitätsstandards dynamische Schallwandler,
Mikrofone, Hörsprechgarnituren und Handapparate für den professionellen Einsatz. Unsere Kunden
kommen aus der Luftfahrt, ÖPNV und Bahntechnik, BOS, Leitstellentechnik sowie Defence.

[MEHR ERFAHREN][34]

### Elektroakustische Produkte

Unsere Produkte bieten höchste Sprachverständlichkeit und zuverlässige Kommunikation – insbesondere
unter anspruchsvollsten und rauen Einsatzbedingungen.

### Made in Germany

Von der Idee bis zum marktreifen Produkt : Alle Entwicklungs- und Produktionsschritte finden an
unserem Standort in Berlin statt.

### Mitarbeitende

200 Mitarbeitende sorgen dafür, dass unsere Kunden hochwertige Produkte erhalten, die an ihre
Bedürfnisse angepasst sind.

### Höchste Qualität

Wir sind zertifiziert nach DIN EN ISO 9100 und sind genehmigter Herstellungs- sowie
Instandhaltungsbetrieb für Luftfahrtgeräte gemäß EASA.

### Nachhaltigkeit

Durch nachhaltige Lösungen und die fortlaufende Verbesserung unserer Prozesse stellen wir eine
effiziente und zukunftsorientierte Arbeitsweise sicher.

### Umweltmanagement

2019 habe wir ein Umweltmanagementsystem nach DIN EN ISO 14001 aufgebaut und sind seit 2021 bei der
Plattform EcoVadis registriert (EcoVadis Silver 2025).

## Innovation als Tradition

Von der analogen Technik bis ins digitale Zeitalter: Seit über einhundert Jahren steht die Marke
**HOLM**CO für die verlässliche Übertragung von Sprachsignalen zur Kommunikation in geräuschvoller
und rauer Umgebung.

Ob auf See, an Land oder in der Luft, überall sind Produkte von Holmberg zuverlässig im
professionellen Einsatz. Anforderungen und Technologien haben sich in den letzten Jahrzehnten rasant
verändert, ebenso wie das Umfeld, in dem sich der Mensch bewegt und kommuniziert.

Wir sind für die sichere Kommunikation unserer Kunden immer in Bewegung. Denn Innovation ist unsere
Tradition.

## Unsere Geschäftsfelder

### Luftfahrt

Ausgezeichnete Sprachverständlichkeit für Luft und Boden
[MEHR ERFAHREN][35]

### Verteidigung

Zuverlässige Kommunikation für Schutz und Verteidigung
[MEHR ERFAHREN][36]

### Schiff & Marine

Klare Kommunikation auch bei rauen Bedingungen auf See
[MEHR ERFAHREN][37]

### BOS

Im Einsatz sicher vernetzt
[MEHR ERFAHREN][38]

### ÖPNV & Bahn

Verlässliche Verbindung für Straße und Schiene
[MEHR ERFAHREN][39]

### Leitstellen

Präzise planen und schnell entscheiden
[MEHR ERFAHREN][40]

## Kontaktieren Sie uns jetzt

Die Anforderungen an unsere Produkte sind so unterschiedlich wie die Bereiche, in denen sie
eingesetzt werden.
Daher passen wir unsere Produkte an Ihre individuellen Bedürfnisse an und
entwickeln kundenspezifische Lösungen nach Maß.

[ANGEBOT EINHOLEN][41]

** [About The Homebuilt Homepage][1] **

The Homebuilt Homepage is an index and reference on Homebuilt Experimental class aircraft and
related information. This is a non-profit website. Links to this site are welcome.
The following data is provided for information purposes only. Being listed on the Homebuilt Homepage
does not constitute any guarantee or recommendation on the part of the Homebuilt Homepage, nor is
any guarantee made as to the accuracy of information on these pages. The reader is advised to
contact the specific aircraft manufacturer directly. And remember that buyer beware is sound advice.

[ ** Kits and Plans**][2]
Currently available kits and plans for Homebuilt Aircraft.

[ ** Homebuilt Aircraft**][3]
Homebuilt Aircraft under development, no longer available, one of a kind, and builder/fan websites.

[ ** Vendors**][4]
Vendors of parts, supplies, services, software, books and magazines for homebuilders.

[ ** Homebuilders Directory**][5]
People that have built or are flying Homebuilt Aircraft.

[ ** Clubs and Newsletters**][6]
Clubs and newsletters of interest to homebuilders.

[ ** Miscellaneous Information**][7]
Things that don't have a place elsewhere.

[ ** Technical Information**][8]
Aerodynamics, design information, airfoils, regulations, software, etc.

[ ** Homebuilding Calendar**][9]
Upcoming fly-ins, builder's workshops, EAA Chapter events, Homebuilt club activities, and more.

[ ** Other Aviation Websites**][10]
Non-Homebuilt related aviation links.

# Welcome to Houston Aircraft Instruments, Inc. (HAI)

**HAI** is a global leader in the repair and overhaul of aircraft instrumentation and accessories,
spanning over 51 years. We provide superior, reliable, and cost effective services for a broad
spectrum of the aviation industry, including general/commercial/corporate aviation, helicopter
operations, and government and military customers.
* [[Houston Aircraft Instruments Headquarters - Pearland, TX] ][33]

Houston Aircraft Instruments, Inc. Headquarters – Pearland, TX

We are committed to providing our customers with outstanding quality service. Our company was built
on integrity, honesty, and excellence in every aspect of the services we have to offer. We also
believe in keeping the cost reasonable, while maintaining exceptional quality that either meets or
exceeds Original Aircraft Manufacturer (OEM) specifications.

At HAI, your success and safety is our number one priority. Our dedicated professional team
understands the importance of exceptional customer service and will provide the solution to your
aircraft instrument and accessory needs.

Please take the time to explore our site and learn more about HAI’s services. Let us know how we can
help you. [Contact Us Now!][34]

## **ICON A5
## **Discover Adventure Flying

[Request a Demo Flight][36]

The ICON A5 reinvents recreational aviation and lets you bring the exhilaration of flight to life
like never before. Sport flying with the A5 is tailored to pilots who primarily fly for recreation —
easy to fly, lightweight, and low operating costs.

### Choose your ICON A5

### ICON A5 LSA

For U.S. based pilots, the ICON A5 is the latest model. Designed for current and prospective pilots
of all skill levels.

[View Now][37]

### FAA-Type Certified Edition

Customers taking ownership outside of the U.S. can explore the Type-Certified Edition of the ICON A5

[Learn More][38]

### Safety comes standard.

Learn about the A5’s Spin-Resistant Airframe and ICON Parachute System. If you encounter the
unexpected, we’ve got you covered. Literally.

[ICON Safety Innovation][39]

### Not a pilot yet? Not a problem.

Whether flying is something you already do or something you’ve always dreamt of doing but thought
was out of reach, ICON’s Flight Training experiences are intended to show you how to get the most
from the A5 in its unique operating environment.

[ICON Flight Training][40]

### The FAA Has Granted Type Certification for the ICON A5

ICON Aircraft today announced that the FAA has granted Type Certification for the ICON A5 in the
primary category, dramatically expanding the international market for our award-winning amphibious
aircraft.

[View Release][41]

### Become an A5 Owner

Learn about ICON A5 Ownership

[Learn More][42]

### Come fly with us

Experience the A5 at an event near you.

[Learn More][43]


###### Learn More About The **ICON Lifestyle** And **Becoming A Pilot**. Read The Latest Offerings

To date our community has made over 100 million downloads. It’s based on principles of collaboration, unobstructed discovery, and, most importantly, scientific progression. As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. [Authors, Editors and Institutions][10] We are a community of more than 103,000 authors and editors from 3,291 institutions spanning 160 countries, including Nobel Prize winners and some of the world’s most-cited researchers. Publishing on IntechOpen allows authors to earn citations and find new collaborators, meaning more people see your work not only from your own field of study, but from other related fields too. # Overview

### Discover the story and specifications behind today’s premium business aircraft and helicopters
### and let your imagination be inspired to take flight…

JetBook is the world’s most comprehensive guide to the world of business aircraft and helicopters in
the world today. Packed with gorgeous, full-color photography of the aircraft flying with full
details and specifications from the manufacturers, this edition of the book is the ultimate book for
aviation industry lovers around the world. More than just a visual treat, the 288 pages of the
award-winning publication reveal the details, facts, and statistics that tell the story of each
aircraft, revealing their layout, flight range and performance, and even the latest prices. Combined
with comparison charts and graphs, this book gives its readers all the information they need to
know. The fourth edition includes a unique section which can assist and inspire anyone who might be
considering the purchase of an aircraft. This series of articles brings you an essential guide in
your decisions to find the right form of aircraft ownership, advising on decision if brand new plane
or a pre-owned jet, select the most suitable aircraft, efficiently use your jet for your
corporation, the possibilities from high-end luxury completion services in designing a custom wide
body aircraft cabin and choose the right maintenance provider for your aircraft type and much more.

Accompanying a full profile of each of the 54 business jets and 31 helicopters are interviews with
four industry leaders. Also included are in-depth profiles of the world’s leading aircraft and
helicopter manufacturers today, including Gulfstream, Bombardier, Dassault, Boeing, Airbus, Cessna
and HondaJet among others. No other guide on the marketplace can match the vision and depth of
JetBook, the making of which took a full two years of dedicated research from the author and her
team. [JetBook][25] is a one-of-a-kind book. Now, in this updated edition, readers can enjoy an
inclusive snapshot of the business aircraft and helicopter industry as it stands today. [Order
JetBook][26], The Complete Guide to Aircraft and Helicopters today, set your sights to the sky, and
soar! JetBook presents the complete portfolio of business jets and helicopters, plus a series of
interviews with aviation leaders. Printed on premium matt paper the JetBook is 288 pages long and
measures: 295x240mm, the book is a hard cover edition with registered ISBN 978-80-11-04188-5.

[JetBook logo]

##### The Ultimate Guide to Business Aircraft and Helicopters

Enjoy our new expanded JetBook 2023/24 edition with 50 more pages of Buyer's guide section, all new
fleet comparisions, updated exclusive images of all current business jets and helicoptes and new
yacht section.

[Order Now][27]

# Overview

### Discover the story and specifications behind today’s premium business aircraft and helicopters
### and let your imagination be inspired to take flight…

JetBook is the world’s most comprehensive guide to the world of business aircraft and helicopters in
the world today. Packed with gorgeous, full-color photography of the aircraft flying with full
details and specifications from the manufacturers, this edition of the book is the ultimate book for
aviation industry lovers around the world. More than just a visual treat, the 288 pages of the
award-winning publication reveal the details, facts, and statistics that tell the story of each
aircraft, revealing their layout, flight range and performance, and even the latest prices. Combined
with comparison charts and graphs, this book gives its readers all the information they need to
know. The fourth edition includes a unique section which can assist and inspire anyone who might be
considering the purchase of an aircraft. This series of articles brings you an essential guide in
your decisions to find the right form of aircraft ownership, advising on decision if brand new plane
or a pre-owned jet, select the most suitable aircraft, efficiently use your jet for your
corporation, the possibilities from high-end luxury completion services in designing a custom wide
body aircraft cabin and choose the right maintenance provider for your aircraft type and much more.

Accompanying a full profile of each of the 54 business jets and 31 helicopters are interviews with
four industry leaders. Also included are in-depth profiles of the world’s leading aircraft and
helicopter manufacturers today, including Gulfstream, Bombardier, Dassault, Boeing, Airbus, Cessna
and HondaJet among others. No other guide on the marketplace can match the vision and depth of
JetBook, the making of which took a full two years of dedicated research from the author and her
team. [JetBook][25] is a one-of-a-kind book. Now, in this updated edition, readers can enjoy an
inclusive snapshot of the business aircraft and helicopter industry as it stands today. [Order
JetBook][26], The Complete Guide to Aircraft and Helicopters today, set your sights to the sky, and
soar! JetBook presents the complete portfolio of business jets and helicopters, plus a series of

## **
## 
## The Art of Building Your Custom Aircraft **


At JMB Aircraft, you design the aircraft right down to the smallest detail. From the avionics that
guide your flight, through the interior that surrounds you in comfort and style, to the exterior
design which turns heads on the ground - you have complete freedom.
‍

Our exteriors are hand-painted, with every curve and contour crafted by skilled artisans. No colour
is too bold, no finish too complex.
‍

Inside, you’ll feel the difference of true craftsmanship. Every seat, panel, and detail is hand-sewn
or custom-fitted from luxurious Alcantara, premium leather or a combination of materials. There are
no limitations - your aircraft becomes a reflection of your vision, personality and style.
‍

This is more than customisation - it’s a journey from imagination to reality, where your dreams
truly come to life.
[LEARN MORE][20]

## **Unique Production Facility with Atelier & Guest Lounge.**

Our facilities cover over 8,000 m² spread across five combined production sites throughout Europe.
From these facilities four new aircraft take to the skies every month. Each space is designed not
only to support production, but also to welcome our customers. Our atelier inspires you to create
that unique look for your aircraft, our customer lounge relaxes you during your visit, and our
briefing room prepares you for the flight ahead.  This is just a small part of the complete JMB
Aircraft experience.

## We Fly Everywhere! 

From the USA to South America, across Europe, and all the way down to South Africa, Australia, and
New Zealand - JMB Aircraft is visible all over the world.
‍

We bring our aircraft directly to the customer through **demo days**, where potential pilots can
experience the VL3 and discover firsthand the performance, comfort and craftsmanship that make our
planes unique.
‍
[view MORE][21]

## News and stories from the JMB world.

[
700 Times We Said “Ready for Takeoff.”
Seven hundred first flights, seven hundred smiles, and seven hundred dreams turned into reality. We
have officially handed over VL3 Serial Number 700, a milestone that celebrates not just engineering
excellence, but the incredible people who make JMB Aircraft fly.
13.7.2026
Press
][22]
[
Heading to Oshkosh 2026? Visit us at our booth!
From modern speed to timeless biplane classics, JMB Aircraft is bringing exciting lineup to EAA
AirVenture 2026. You can find our team and all on-display aircraft at Booth 275/276.
1.7.2026
Exhibitions
Events & Demo
][23]
[
SV4-RS Demo Tour: On the Way to Oshkosh
The legendary SV4-RS, a combination of timeless design and modern technology, is heading across the
United States for its first tour. Check out the schedule and join us on our journey to Oshkosh!
30.6.2026
Events & Demo
][24]
[
Seven VL3s Reach Iceland After Challenging North Atlantic Crossing
Raid Iceland 2026 reaches major milestone as all seven VL3 aircraft successfully arrive in
Egilsstaðir, Iceland, following one of the most demanding stages of the expedition.
17.6.2026
Press

discover the performance and innovation of the VL3 powered by the Rotax 916iS engine.

such as cabin products, material pooling and digital fleet support. Our customers include airlines,
lessors, governments, and private jet owners. We are passionate about keeping your asset flying and

trust and innovation, our company grew from a small airplane hangar in East Aurora into a global
leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and

way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

“We make you fly safe and on time”

# Here we are

## Tailored solutions

Line, base, and specialised maintenance for all commercial aircraft in Europe since 1974, tailored
to your needs.

[ Explore our services ][35]

## 50+

Years experience

## 60+

Stations

## 1250+

Employees

## 240

Satisfied customers
Celebrating 50 Years

## Explore our history

[ History ][36]
Celebrating 50 Years

### Explore our history

[ History ][37]

## What can Nayak do for you?

What we can do for you is guarantee you’ll never need anyone else!

Anytime, anywhere, here we are! And we’ve got you covered.

Nayak Aircraft Services is an independent MRO, specialised in maximizing fleet performance.
Servicing over 240 airlines with over 60 stations across all of Europe, and supporting Boeing,
Airbus, Embraer & Fokker aircraft around the globe, Nayak strives to be the optimal maintenance
provider, providing our customers with the best and most reliable cost-conscious solutions. A big
responsibility that requires a great deal of organization and commitment.

Here we are, with 50 years of experience in the field. Nayak is the ideal choice as your aircraft
service provider. Quick-thinking, with expert knowledge and the tools to tackle the most
unanticipated problems, Nayak is on call 24/7, 365 days a year, working on your aircraft to ensure
safe and on-time departure!

[ Services ][38] [ Go to Booklet ][39]

### We build careers

If aircraft could talk, they’d ask for Nayak. And if you’re looking to build a career in aviation,
you’ll want to be here too.

With over 50 years of expertise, Nayak is more than an MRO – it’s a launchpad for your professional
growth. We don’t just maintain aircraft – we build careers.

[ Careers ][40]

## Approvals

Nayak holds a variety of international acknowledged certificates among others:

[ Approvals ][41]

## View our service booklet

Nayak provides extensive services throughout the Nayak network. A full overview is given in our
booklet of services, which can be found here.

[ Go to Booklet ][42] [Our services][43]

## Since 1974

50+ years of experience in the MRO network as private and airline independent organization serving
worldwide carriers.

 

www.nayak.aero

Nayak LM GmbH
DUS-Air-Cargo-Center/Eingang D
Frachtstraße 26,
40474 Düsseldorf, Germany

# Безопасная, конфиденциальная, профессиональная эксплуатация корпоративных воздушных судов

[Подробнее][36]
Авиакомпания «Северо-Запад»

## О нас

За 16 лет работы «Авиакомпания «Северо-Запад» накопила солидный опыт в организации
VIP-авиаперевозок, заявила о себе, как о серьёзном участнике рынка. Приоритеты компании:
конфиденциальность, безопасность, комфорт.

Под управлением компании находятся воздушные суда самых известных мировых авиапроизводителей:
Gulfstream Aerospace, Bombardier Aerospace, Dassault Aviation, Leonardo Helicopters, Airbus. Базовые
аэропорты находятся в Москве и Санкт-Петербурге.

Преимуществом компании является наличие собственной диспетчерской службы 24/7 и собственных
представителей в региональных аэропортах.

[Подробнее ][37]

## Airbus A321neo

Первый коммерческий рейс Airbus A321NEO
авиакомпании «Северо-Запад»

[Первый полёт Airbus A321neo авиакомпании Северо-запад]

В парк Авиакомпании «Северо-Запад» поступили два воздушных судна нового поколения A321 NEO в
моноклассе. Оба воздушных судна оборудованы салонами экономического класса, рассчитаны на перевозку
**236 пассажиров**, оснащены высокоэкономичными двигателями CFM LEAP-1A и признаны одними из
наиболее экологичных и тихих в своем классе.

Лайнеры с бортовыми номерами **RA-73027** и **RA-73028**, в указанной конфигурации, стали первыми
воздушными судами, внесенными в Государственный реестр гражданских воздушных судов Российской
Федерации.

Первый рейс RA-73027, состоявшийся **24 сентября 2021 года** был символично приурочен к открытию
аэропорта Тобольск, что стало очевидным свидетельством развития авиаотрасли Российской Федерации как
в части расширения количественного состава парков авиакомпаний, так и в части развития аэропортовой
инфраструктуры страны.

В настоящий момент флот Авиакомпании «Северо-Запад» насчитывает **23 воздушных судна**. Все они
ввезены в Российскую Федерацию и зарегистрированы в Государственном реестре гражданских воздушных
судов Российской Федерации. При этом, эксплуатация двух A321 NEO, новое направление деятельности
Авиакомпании, основным профилем которой, до этого момента, была сфера бизнес-авиации и, эксплуатация
таких типов воздушных судов как Gulfstream GVI, Gulfstream GV-SP, Falcon 7X, Falcon 900, Challenger
650, AW-139.

[Подробнее][36]
Авиакомпания «Северо-Запад»

## О нас

За 16 лет работы «Авиакомпания «Северо-Запад» накопила солидный опыт в организации
VIP-авиаперевозок, заявила о себе, как о серьёзном участнике рынка. Приоритеты компании:
конфиденциальность, безопасность, комфорт.

Под управлением компании находятся воздушные суда самых известных мировых авиапроизводителей:
Gulfstream Aerospace, Bombardier Aerospace, Dassault Aviation, Leonardo Helicopters, Airbus. Базовые
аэропорты находятся в Москве и Санкт-Петербурге.

Преимуществом компании является наличие собственной диспетчерской службы 24/7 и собственных
представителей в региональных аэропортах.

[Подробнее ][37]

## Airbus A321neo

Первый коммерческий рейс Airbus A321NEO
авиакомпании «Северо-Запад»

[Первый полёт Airbus A321neo авиакомпании Северо-запад]

В парк Авиакомпании «Северо-Запад» поступили два воздушных судна нового поколения A321 NEO в
моноклассе. Оба воздушных судна оборудованы салонами экономического класса, рассчитаны на перевозку
**236 пассажиров**, оснащены высокоэкономичными двигателями CFM LEAP-1A и признаны одними из
наиболее экологичных и тихих в своем классе.

Лайнеры с бортовыми номерами **RA-73027** и **RA-73028**, в указанной конфигурации, стали первыми
воздушными судами, внесенными в Государственный реестр гражданских воздушных судов Российской
Федерации.

Первый рейс RA-73027, состоявшийся **24 сентября 2021 года** был символично приурочен к открытию
аэропорта Тобольск, что стало очевидным свидетельством развития авиаотрасли Российской Федерации как
в части расширения количественного состава парков авиакомпаний, так и в части развития аэропортовой
инфраструктуры страны.

В настоящий момент флот Авиакомпании «Северо-Запад» насчитывает **23 воздушных судна**. Все они
ввезены в Российскую Федерацию и зарегистрированы в Государственном реестре гражданских воздушных
судов Российской Федерации. При этом, эксплуатация двух A321 NEO, новое направление деятельности
Авиакомпании, основным профилем которой, до этого момента, была сфера бизнес-авиации и, эксплуатация
таких типов воздушных судов как Gulfstream GVI, Gulfstream GV-SP, Falcon 7X, Falcon 900, Challenger
650, AW-139.

## Explore Our Services

[ [Technicians performing Mobile GSE Repair services] ][102]

### Mobile GSE Repair

Keep your ground support equipment in peak condition with our mobile GSE service. Our expert team
brings onsite maintenance directly to you, saving you time, minimizing disruptions, and reducing
costs. Fully equipped to handle everything from routine maintenance to annual inspections, we ensure
your equipment stays flight-ready. With PJi, you can focus on your operations while we keep your GSE
performing at its best - We Keep You Flying®!

[Learn More About Mobile GSE Repair ][103]
[ [Technicians performing GSE maintenance on various equipment] ][104]

### GSE Service

Pilot John is committed to meeting your GSE maintenance needs to keep your aircraft flight ready.
Regular preventative maintenance is vital to keeping downtime to a minimum. Our service technicians
keep your equipment performing at optimum working conditions by performing routine maintenance on
motorized GSE such as ground power units, lav and water carts, and aircraft tugs, as well as
non-motorized GSE like towbars and axle jacks.

[Learn More About GSE Service ][105]
[ [Technicians working with calibration tools and equipment] ][106]

### Calibration Services

Our expert calibration technicians are capable of calibrating and servicing a wide range of aircraft
tools, gauges, and testing equipment, from torque wrenches to tensiometers, and so much more.

[Learn More About Calibration Services ][107]
[ [Minimize AOG time with flexible GSE rentals, featuring aircraft tug in use.] ][108]

### GSE Rentals

Minimize AOG time with our flexible GSE rentals, offering a wide selection of high-quality ground
support equipment. Whether you need short- or long-term solutions, renting from Pilot John helps you
save on costs, avoid equipment obsolescence, and keep operations running smoothly. Our team of
experts is dedicated to providing tailored solutions and top-tier service. Stay Flight-Ready® and
keep your fleet moving with our GSE rental options.

[Learn More About GSE Rentals ][109]
[ [Avionics Test Equipment Rentals for aircraft systems] ][110]

### Avionics Test Equipment Rentals

Ensure your aircraft is always ready with our avionics test equipment rentals. Offering a
comprehensive range of high-quality test equipment for both short- and long-term needs, we help you
avoid costly investments while maintaining peak operational performance. Our avionics team is ready
to provide tailored solutions that meet your specific requirements. Stay Flight-Ready® and keep your
systems operating flawlessly.

[Learn More About Avionics Test Equipment Rentals ][111]
[ [Business financing options for aviation equipment] ][112]

### Financing

With in-house financing, you can avoid complications from outside parties. Simply complete a
straightforward credit application, and receive a prompt decision on financing. Pilot John
International offers flexible options, allowing you to scale according to your business strategy
changes. By securing financing through Pilot John, you ensure operational efficiency, minimize
downtime, and keeping your equipment up to date for optimal business performance.

[Learn More About Financing ][113]

## Explore Our Services

[ [Technicians performing Mobile GSE Repair services] ][102]

### Mobile GSE Repair

Keep your ground support equipment in peak condition with our mobile GSE service. Our expert team
brings onsite maintenance directly to you, saving you time, minimizing disruptions, and reducing
costs. Fully equipped to handle everything from routine maintenance to annual inspections, we ensure
your equipment stays flight-ready. With PJi, you can focus on your operations while we keep your GSE
performing at its best - We Keep You Flying®!

[Learn More About Mobile GSE Repair ][103]
[ [Technicians performing GSE maintenance on various equipment] ][104]

### GSE Service

Pilot John is committed to meeting your GSE maintenance needs to keep your aircraft flight ready.
Regular preventative maintenance is vital to keeping downtime to a minimum. Our service technicians
keep your equipment performing at optimum working conditions by performing routine maintenance on
motorized GSE such as ground power units, lav and water carts, and aircraft tugs, as well as
non-motorized GSE like towbars and axle jacks.

[Learn More About GSE Service ][105]
[ [Technicians working with calibration tools and equipment] ][106]

### Calibration Services

Our expert calibration technicians are capable of calibrating and servicing a wide range of aircraft
tools, gauges, and testing equipment, from torque wrenches to tensiometers, and so much more.

[Learn More About Calibration Services ][107]
[ [Minimize AOG time with flexible GSE rentals, featuring aircraft tug in use.] ][108]

### GSE Rentals

Minimize AOG time with our flexible GSE rentals, offering a wide selection of high-quality ground
support equipment. Whether you need short- or long-term solutions, renting from Pilot John helps you
save on costs, avoid equipment obsolescence, and keep operations running smoothly. Our team of
experts is dedicated to providing tailored solutions and top-tier service. Stay Flight-Ready® and
keep your fleet moving with our GSE rental options.

[Learn More About GSE Rentals ][109]
[ [Avionics Test Equipment Rentals for aircraft systems] ][110]

### Avionics Test Equipment Rentals

Ensure your aircraft is always ready with our avionics test equipment rentals. Offering a
comprehensive range of high-quality test equipment for both short- and long-term needs, we help you
avoid costly investments while maintaining peak operational performance. Our avionics team is ready
to provide tailored solutions that meet your specific requirements. Stay Flight-Ready® and keep your
systems operating flawlessly.

[Learn More About Avionics Test Equipment Rentals ][111]
[ [Business financing options for aviation equipment] ][112]

### Financing

With in-house financing, you can avoid complications from outside parties. Simply complete a
straightforward credit application, and receive a prompt decision on financing. Pilot John
International offers flexible options, allowing you to scale according to your business strategy
changes. By securing financing through Pilot John, you ensure operational efficiency, minimize
downtime, and keeping your equipment up to date for optimal business performance.

[Learn More About Financing ][113]

## Become a Private Pilot

From jets to single-engine prop planes, explore the innovative engineering, the costs and rich

Get to know famous aviators throughout history and delve into the extensive training and skills
required to earn a private pilot’s license.

Explore our aviation calculators, resources that guide you through flight simulators, navigation
charts, pilot apps to enhance your aviation skills.

[Explore the M700 Fury][106]

Business. Adventure. The Better Life.

## A Piper Aircraft for **All Scenarios**

When Mr. Piper introduced the Piper Cub in 1937, he had a dream – the freedom of flight for
everyone. Over 130,000 aircraft later, generations have lived that dream. Training in Pipers.
Serious business transportation in Pipers. Pipers bring a higher level of safety, technology and
performance to enhance the lives of owners. Piper is the Freedom of Flight.

Testimonials

## Stories That Take Flight

Allen Hancock

New Bern, USA

“I became very active in the PA-32 Owner’s and Pilots Facebook Group and eventually spearheaded a
group fly-in which became the largest gathering of its type in history. We had the full support of
Piper Aircraft, as well as many other major aviation brands and fulfilled my personal goal to have
accomplished something truly meaningful in aviation.”

Chris Hibben

Oshkosh, USA

“I use the M600 to support our airshow business, Chambliss Aerobatics. The M600 is used to transport
team members and spare parts for our airshow airplane. Its range, payload and versatility make it
the perfect plane for my business. The M600’s speed and handling qualities make it a sheer joy to
fly, and that makes it the perfect airplane for me.”

Shadi Wadi-Ramahi

Evansville, USA

“During winters, my wife and I flew with our twins to the Bahamas and all around Florida. We have
made many other memorable weekend trips to places like Niagara Falls, Nashville and Myrtle Beach… I
have stuck with Piper all these years because of the performance, safety, and value. I have trusted
the reliability of Piper in flying my family to numerous destinations over the last 25 years and
look forward to continuing to do so.”

# Piper is Proud to Introduce the M700 Fury

[Explore the M700 Fury][106]

Business. Adventure. The Better Life.

## A Piper Aircraft for **All Scenarios**

When Mr. Piper introduced the Piper Cub in 1937, he had a dream – the freedom of flight for
everyone. Over 130,000 aircraft later, generations have lived that dream. Training in Pipers.
Serious business transportation in Pipers. Pipers bring a higher level of safety, technology and
performance to enhance the lives of owners. Piper is the Freedom of Flight.

Testimonials

## Stories That Take Flight

Allen Hancock

New Bern, USA

“I became very active in the PA-32 Owner’s and Pilots Facebook Group and eventually spearheaded a
group fly-in which became the largest gathering of its type in history. We had the full support of
Piper Aircraft, as well as many other major aviation brands and fulfilled my personal goal to have
accomplished something truly meaningful in aviation.”

Chris Hibben

Oshkosh, USA

“I use the M600 to support our airshow business, Chambliss Aerobatics. The M600 is used to transport
team members and spare parts for our airshow airplane. Its range, payload and versatility make it
the perfect plane for my business. The M600’s speed and handling qualities make it a sheer joy to
fly, and that makes it the perfect airplane for me.”

Shadi Wadi-Ramahi

Evansville, USA

“During winters, my wife and I flew with our twins to the Bahamas and all around Florida. We have
made many other memorable weekend trips to places like Niagara Falls, Nashville and Myrtle Beach… I
have stuck with Piper all these years because of the performance, safety, and value. I have trusted
the reliability of Piper in flying my family to numerous destinations over the last 25 years and
look forward to continuing to do so.”

backed by Textron’s 100 years of expertise and restless spirit of innovation.”

**Gabriel Massey**
General Manager, Pipistrel

[Voyager][42]

The trainer positioned for the MOSAIC era of aviation and built to empower future pilots.

[Velis Electro][43]

First ever type-certified electric-powered aircraft, fully approved for pilot training in Day VFR
operations.

[Alpha Trainer][44]

Combining performance and efficiency, the smart training choice is equipped with all essential
features for success.

[Pipistrel Explorer aircraft flying high above greenery and power lines]
[Explorer][45]

The highest performing aircraft in the CS-LSA category, experience durability, speed and advanced
flying capability.

Why Choose

## RFS Rapco Fleet Support FAA-PMA Brake Components

### A Better Brake Part from Design to Delivery

To get FAA-PMA approval for our brake parts, we set the bar high. Our designs, engineering, testing,
manufacturing, quality control, and quality assurance are comprehensive and rigorous. We document
thousands of dynamometer test landings and FAA regulated flight tests which include, but are not
limited to, max weight landings, water contaminated runway landings and rejected take-offs. Quite
simply, we build the safest, longest-lasting, best-performing brake parts.

### Faster Turnaround

There are many advantages to having a comprehensive all-in-house system. For starters, we’re far
more proactive, innovative, and responsive than our OEM counterparts. RFS manufactures and stocks
all our parts right here in Hartland, Wisconsin USA. In most cases, orders ship the same day. Our
professional, experienced and courteous staff is here to support you from sales to installation.

### Serious Savings

Because RFS is a comprehensive all-in-house system, we can pass on substantial savings in efficiency
and cost to you. For example, we stock convenient Hot-Pac Brake Overhaul Kits among individual
components and we have actual professionals serving our customers—from sales questions to technical
issues.

When considering OEM vs. PMA parts, it ultimately comes down to price. There really is no
competition. Our PMA parts will beat OEM prices every time.

## What Really Comes with These Boxes?

All of our customers have experienced the differences between Rapco Fleet Support, Inc. and the big
OEMs. We’re smaller, nimbler, easy to work with, and a lot less expensive. They’re the opposite.

The only similarity is both products are installed in the same wheel assembly with FAA-PMA
installation authority. When OEM parts are installed as a replacement, eligibility is through
FAA-PMA authority. Same as our brake parts.

The OEM’s received their PMA by simply being on the aircraft when the TC holder received
certification. We earned PMA by proving performance with hundreds of stops on a dynamometer and a
strict FAA mandated flight test schedule. Testing included normal landings under different
conditions as well as at wear-limit Rejected Takeoffs.

Our brake parts actually exceed OEM performance standards and airworthiness requirements.

At RFS, safety is our number one priority. There is no compromise when the aviation industry has to
contend with escalating fuel and maintenance costs. Survival demands vigilant budgeting wherever
possible without any trade-offs. This is where Rapco Fleet Support takes off.

Rapco Fleet Support's FAA-PMA brake components are of the highest quality and offer superior value
compared to what OEMs offer. Since the early 1990s, our aviation brake products have helped regional
airlines and corporate fleet operators dramatically reduce expenses without a single Airworthiness
Directive.

Rapco Fleet Support manufactures brake components for some of the most widely used fleet and
corporate aircraft. We take pride in our ability to quickly get the highest quality PMA parts to our
customers through a worldwide network of distributors. All RFS brake components are made entirely in
the USA.

Why Choose

## RFS Rapco Fleet Support FAA-PMA Brake Components

### A Better Brake Part from Design to Delivery

To get FAA-PMA approval for our brake parts, we set the bar high. Our designs, engineering, testing,
manufacturing, quality control, and quality assurance are comprehensive and rigorous. We document
thousands of dynamometer test landings and FAA regulated flight tests which include, but are not
limited to, max weight landings, water contaminated runway landings and rejected take-offs. Quite
simply, we build the safest, longest-lasting, best-performing brake parts.

### Faster Turnaround

There are many advantages to having a comprehensive all-in-house system. For starters, we’re far
more proactive, innovative, and responsive than our OEM counterparts. RFS manufactures and stocks
all our parts right here in Hartland, Wisconsin USA. In most cases, orders ship the same day. Our
professional, experienced and courteous staff is here to support you from sales to installation.

### Serious Savings

Because RFS is a comprehensive all-in-house system, we can pass on substantial savings in efficiency
and cost to you. For example, we stock convenient Hot-Pac Brake Overhaul Kits among individual
components and we have actual professionals serving our customers—from sales questions to technical
issues.

When considering OEM vs. PMA parts, it ultimately comes down to price. There really is no
competition. Our PMA parts will beat OEM prices every time.

## What Really Comes with These Boxes?

All of our customers have experienced the differences between Rapco Fleet Support, Inc. and the big
OEMs. We’re smaller, nimbler, easy to work with, and a lot less expensive. They’re the opposite.

The only similarity is both products are installed in the same wheel assembly with FAA-PMA
installation authority. When OEM parts are installed as a replacement, eligibility is through
FAA-PMA authority. Same as our brake parts.

The OEM’s received their PMA by simply being on the aircraft when the TC holder received
certification. We earned PMA by proving performance with hundreds of stops on a dynamometer and a
strict FAA mandated flight test schedule. Testing included normal landings under different
conditions as well as at wear-limit Rejected Takeoffs.

Our brake parts actually exceed OEM performance standards and airworthiness requirements.

We adhere to a strict [FAA/PMA approval process][56] to ensure our brake components are fit for

### Custom Bearing Design:

When high standards for bearing quality and performance are critical, our technical team is equipped
with the most advanced precision instruments to assess your bearing application needs. Our team of

Our Bearing Design Solutions and catalog of prespecified precision bearings always meet or exceed

We also have decades of experience designing bearings and creating bearing standards for a variety
of industries including medical equipment, automation & robotics, and machinery for construction and
agricultural applications.

### A Team and Facility You Can Trust.

We manufacture all of our products in our AS9100 Rev D / ISO9001:2015 & Nadcap certified facility in
Poughkeepsie, NY and can easily achieve tolerances measured in millionths of an inch.

## Aerospace Ball Bearing Clients

[aerospace ball bearing applications]

Schatz is an aircraft ball bearing manufacturer with products that are approved to standards from
the likes of Boeing and the U.S. military. Unlike a supplier of bearings for ceiling fans or
consumer appliances, Schatz specializes in the design of manufacturing of [precision ball
bearings][219] for civilian and military aviation. Our quality management system is AS9100D
certified, but that’s just part of what makes us a trusted aircraft bearing manufacturer. Keep
reading to learn more, or [view our on-line catalog][220] of Made in USA aircraft bearings.

## **AS9100D Certified Bearing Manufacturer**

[AS9100D][221] is a quality standard for the aircraft, space and defense industry that has been
endorsed by the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), the National Aeronautics and Space
Administration (NASA), and the Department of Defense (DoD). Revision D (AS9100D) is the current
version of AS9100, which also references standards such as AS9102 for first article inspection
(FAI). During FAIs, a manufacturer selects parts from a production run for testing, inspection, and
documentation.

After the results are documented, both the physical and functional characteristics of the part are
verified against drawings, purchase orders, specifications, and other design documents. The first
article inspection report (FAIR) includes the actual physical characteristics that were measured
along with any non-conformities. Schatz is also ISO 9001:2015 certified, but our AS9100D
certification means that we’re a manufacturer of aircraft bearings with the FAI and FAIR
capabilities that you need.

documentation.

###### SNC Signs Charter with Northrop Grumman and General Atomics Aeronautical Systems to Deliver
###### Freedom Trainer™ for UJTS

SNC, a global leader in aerospace and national security, today announced it signed an Executive
Charter with Northrop Grumman (NYSE: NOC) and General Atomics Aeronautical Systems, Inc. (GA-ASI) to
define and execute production and manufacturing teaming relationships for its Freedom Trainer™. This
strategic collaboration would combine SNC’s clean-sheet design with the expertise of Northrop
Grumman and GA-ASI, to deliver a zero-compromise training solution for the U.S. Navy’s Undergraduate
Jet Training System (UJTS) program.

**StatRanker.org** is a data-driven publication that organizes official economic and social
statistics into clear country rankings and concise analytical notes. Our work is based on open data
from institutions such as the World Bank, IMF, UN agencies and national statistical offices.

For each topic we select comparable indicators, document the latest available figures and highlight
key trends across countries and regions. Special attention is given to the United States, including
its role in the global economy and comparisons with other major economies.

Charts and tables on StatRanker.org are static visualizations created from these official sources.
They are designed to help researchers, journalists, students and decision-makers quickly understand
how countries differ in terms of growth, inflation, public debt, health expenditure, trade and other
key metrics.

You may reference StatRanker.org as a source in your own articles, reports or presentations, and you
may reproduce our charts or tables for editorial and educational purposes, provided that the content
is not misleadingly altered and a clear attribution such as “Source: StatRanker.org (based on

## How we rank (quick methodology)

StatRanker rankings are built from public datasets and standardized for cross-country comparison.
Each ranking page includes sources, notes, and update timestamps.

[StatRanker]
* Sources
  
  IMF, World Bank, WHO, UN, IEA (and other official datasets depending on the indicator).
* Normalization & units
  
  Values are converted into a single comparable unit (e.g., per capita, PPP, USD/kWh) and clearly
  labeled.
* Update cadence
  
  Rankings are refreshed when new releases become available; each page shows “Updated:” and the
  reference year.
* Limitations
  
  Coverage varies by indicator; missing data, revisions, and methodological differences can affect
  comparability.

**StatRanker.org** is a data-driven publication that organizes official economic and social
statistics into clear country rankings and concise analytical notes. Our work is based on open data
from institutions such as the World Bank, IMF, UN agencies and national statistical offices.

For each topic we select comparable indicators, document the latest available figures and highlight
key trends across countries and regions. Special attention is given to the United States, including
its role in the global economy and comparisons with other major economies.

Charts and tables on StatRanker.org are static visualizations created from these official sources.
They are designed to help researchers, journalists, students and decision-makers quickly understand
how countries differ in terms of growth, inflation, public debt, health expenditure, trade and other
key metrics.

You may reference StatRanker.org as a source in your own articles, reports or presentations, and you
may reproduce our charts or tables for editorial and educational purposes, provided that the content
is not misleadingly altered and a clear attribution such as “Source: StatRanker.org (based on
official data)” is included.

## How we rank (quick methodology)

StatRanker rankings are built from public datasets and standardized for cross-country comparison.
Each ranking page includes sources, notes, and update timestamps.

[StatRanker]
* Sources
  
  IMF, World Bank, WHO, UN, IEA (and other official datasets depending on the indicator).
* Normalization & units
  
  Values are converted into a single comparable unit (e.g., per capita, PPP, USD/kWh) and clearly
  labeled.
* Update cadence
  
  Rankings are refreshed when new releases become available; each page shows “Updated:” and the
  reference year.
* Limitations
  
  Coverage varies by indicator; missing data, revisions, and methodological differences can affect
  comparability.

# Understanding AMOS

Designed by Swiss AviationSoftware (Swiss-AS) based on more than 35 years of experience in aviation
software, AMOS is a comprehensive aircraft maintenance and engineering system trusted by airlines
and MRO providers worldwide. Developed in close collaboration with the aviation community, AMOS
supports maintenance, engineering and logistics processes across the entire operation while ensuring
full regulatory compliance.

Suitable for organisations of all sizes, AMOS combines functional depth with ease of use and
integrates seamlessly into existing IT landscapes. As an industry-leading, future-ready platform,
customers benefit from higher efficiency, better reliability and faster digital transformation.

Configurable for different operators, fleets and business models.

[Discover AMOS][50]

# Understanding AMOS

Designed by Swiss AviationSoftware (Swiss-AS) based on more than 35 years of experience in aviation
software, AMOS is a comprehensive aircraft maintenance and engineering system trusted by airlines
and MRO providers worldwide. Developed in close collaboration with the aviation community, AMOS
supports maintenance, engineering and logistics processes across the entire operation while ensuring
full regulatory compliance.

Suitable for organisations of all sizes, AMOS combines functional depth with ease of use and
integrates seamlessly into existing IT landscapes. As an industry-leading, future-ready platform,
customers benefit from higher efficiency, better reliability and faster digital transformation.

[Live Demo][51]
[Order AMOS brochure][52]

## Key benefits

01

### End-to-end integration

Maintenance, engineering and logistics processes are connected in one system.

02

### Built-in regulatory compliance

Designed to support full airworthiness and audit readiness at all times.

03

### Flexible and scalable

Configurable for different operators, fleets and business models.

04

### Seamless ecosystem connectivity

Open interfaces enable easy integration with existing systems and partners.

05

### Digital and paperless workflows

Mobile solutions support real-time execution at the aircraft and in the office.

06

### Proven in global operations

Trusted by hundreds of organisations across five continents.

[ [plane] ][53]

## Your gateway to seamless digital transformation

AMOS is intuitive, easy to integrate and rich in functionality. Developed by an airline for
airlines, it enables customers to make operations productive and evolve processes over time.
Deployed worldwide, AMOS supports complex maintenance and engineering environments without
compromising usability. Customers retain full ownership of their data and benefit from an open
system architecture that ensures operational autonomy. Based on decades of continuous development,
AMOS provides a stable foundation for long-term digital transformation across aviation maintenance
and engineering.

[Learn more][54]

## Services

Swiss-AS supports customers across the entire AMOS lifecycle. From implementation and training to
ongoing operations and optimisation, our services ensure long-term success and strong system
performance.

[See more][55]
[Wing_Plane]

## Customers

AMOS is trusted by airlines, MRO providers and aviation organisations worldwide. Close collaboration
with customers ensures continuous development aligned with real operational needs.

[See our customers][56]
[test]

## Ecosystem

AMOS is part of a broader Digital Tech Ops Ecosystem that connects maintenance systems, analytics
and digital records through secure interfaces for seamless integration across the organisation.

[Explore the ecosystem][57]
[Plane_Maintance]

## Technology

AMOS runs on a modern, secure and future-ready technology stack with regular releases, high
availability and flexible deployment options to ensure long-term stability and regulatory alignment.

[Explore the technology][58]
[Plane_above]

## A New Era of MRO Service

With over 20 years of in-field experience, TES provides agile maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO)
solutions and support for authorized Honeywell and GE engines and APUs. TES also proudly serves as
the exclusive global distributor of parts for the Challenger 600 series and Learjet 60 aircraft
models.

Whether you face a scheduled maintenance event or unexpected AOG issue, TES representatives will
swiftly arrange a customized maintenance plan to meet your needs. Fly your aircraft to our
FAA-certified facility in Dallas-Fort Worth, or we will fly to you. TES technicians are
strategically stationed across the United States to ensure efficient and reliable MRO support when
and where operators need it most.

## Expanding Footprint

To meet the industry’s increasing demands for MRO services, TES is pleased to introduce a
35,000-square-foot addition to our Dallas-Fort Worth headquarters. Unveiled in 2023, this
state-of-the-art engine and APU shop is prepared to fulfill your maintenance needs, offering
advanced testing equipment backed by industry-best technicians. The new building provides modern,
spacious offices and customer amenities and is conveniently located less than two miles away from
our hangar/fly-in facility.

## Fly-in Services

Minimize both cost and downtime when you fly your aircraft to our service facility at Meacham Field
Airport (KFTW). Flying your airplane to us reduces engine transit time, ensures quicker turnarounds
for your Major Periodic Inspections (MPIs), and allows for rapid return to service via onsite
removal and reinstallation (R&R) plus rental asset support. Our fly-in service hangar neighbors our
new TES engine and APU facility, allowing for seamless coordination and comprehensive maintenance.

## Convenience at Meacham Field (KFTW)

Located near downtown Fort Worth, KFTW offers a rich history and serves as North Texas’ premier
corporate and general aviation facility. Experience superior convenience and efficiency in
maintenance, complemented by top-notch amenities and dedicated teams.
* Two full-service FBOs
* Aircraft maintenance facilities
* Aircraft painting services
* Flight schools for training
* Aircraft charter companies
* Two aviation history museums
* ASOS weather information system
* Onsite rental car facilities
* Onsite Aircraft Fire and Rescue
* Instrument Landing Systems
* 24-hour Air Traffic Control

## A New Era of MRO Service

With over 20 years of in-field experience, TES provides agile maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO)
solutions and support for authorized Honeywell and GE engines and APUs. TES also proudly serves as
the exclusive global distributor of parts for the Challenger 600 series and Learjet 60 aircraft
models.

Whether you face a scheduled maintenance event or unexpected AOG issue, TES representatives will
swiftly arrange a customized maintenance plan to meet your needs. Fly your aircraft to our
FAA-certified facility in Dallas-Fort Worth, or we will fly to you. TES technicians are
strategically stationed across the United States to ensure efficient and reliable MRO support when
and where operators need it most.

## Expanding Footprint

To meet the industry’s increasing demands for MRO services, TES is pleased to introduce a
35,000-square-foot addition to our Dallas-Fort Worth headquarters. Unveiled in 2023, this
state-of-the-art engine and APU shop is prepared to fulfill your maintenance needs, offering
advanced testing equipment backed by industry-best technicians. The new building provides modern,
spacious offices and customer amenities and is conveniently located less than two miles away from
our hangar/fly-in facility.

## Fly-in Services

Minimize both cost and downtime when you fly your aircraft to our service facility at Meacham Field
Airport (KFTW). Flying your airplane to us reduces engine transit time, ensures quicker turnarounds
for your Major Periodic Inspections (MPIs), and allows for rapid return to service via onsite
removal and reinstallation (R&R) plus rental asset support. Our fly-in service hangar neighbors our
new TES engine and APU facility, allowing for seamless coordination and comprehensive maintenance.

## Convenience at Meacham Field (KFTW)

Located near downtown Fort Worth, KFTW offers a rich history and serves as North Texas’ premier
corporate and general aviation facility. Experience superior convenience and efficiency in
maintenance, complemented by top-notch amenities and dedicated teams.
* Two full-service FBOs
* Aircraft maintenance facilities
* Aircraft painting services
* Flight schools for training
* Aircraft charter companies
* Two aviation history museums
* ASOS weather information system
* Onsite rental car facilities
* Onsite Aircraft Fire and Rescue
* Instrument Landing Systems
* 24-hour Air Traffic Control

## WHY VALCOR

## "We Do The Hard Stuff"

### [Why Choose Valcor][205]

We do the hard stuff, and we do it all in Springfield, NJ.  We have never turned down an application
because it was too difficult. Our specialty is in creating a component or system that meets and
exceeds our customer’s most complicated expectations. We have the creativity, legacy, and capability
to turn dreams into robust, reliable products. We can design and manufacture a component, or an
entire system around that component. Our turnkey systems provide our customers with substantial
value in the manufacturing, testing, and installation of those systems. We’re with you every step of
the way, from concept to production, and beyond.  Valcor’s FAA Repair Station provides routine
maintenance, or total refurbishment of all Valcor fluid control products.  We can even repair
products from other manufacturers. Valcor is the only partner you need to provide you with precision
fluid controls, motion controls, and systems.

### [What We Do][206]

We take your specifications and turn them into solutions that work for you.  Relying on a
world-class, highly-creative engineering team that can use the best features from a large catalog of
fluid and motion control products, or create something totally new, gets results that customers
embrace.

Our experienced engineering team can develop applications ranging from commercial laundry soap
dispensing control to the complex roll thruster system on a spacecraft.  No project is too big, or
too small for us to develop. During the development of a new application, we dive deep into the
customer’s system that will use the new component. It is not unusual for us to help our clients
improve the design of their entire system. In many cases, we end up redesigning, and then building
the system in production. This provides our customer with a fully tested turnkey solution ready for
installation in the customer’s product. Our customers fully embrace this truly value-added benefit
of partnering with Valcor Engineering!

Our FAA Repair Station provides Factory-Fresh repairs or refurbishment of your fluid control
components to original specifications using only Valcor Engineering parts and procedures.  Your
factory-serviced component or system will provide you with years of additional service!

### [Why Should You Care][207]

Time is of the essence. Partnering with an industry leading, engineering-driven company who listens
to your needs, then turns them into products that work ensures that you meet your project timelines
without incurring timeline delays and costly redesigns. We get it right the first time!

## WELCOME TO VALCOR ENGINEERING

Your Partner for Every Project

Since 1951, Valcor Engineering  has unceasingly continued to design and manufacture fluid control
components, motion control components, and systems for some of the most demanding applications our
customers have. When you work with Valcor Engineering, you tap into the power of a reliable, proven
partner who supports your program from concept to production, and beyond! It all begins with our
engineering and manufacturing team. Our world-class staff of engineers, designers, and support
technicians utilize a fully-equipped facility designed for the creation, testing, and delivery of
quality fluid control components, motion control components, and systems that meet the most precise
and exacting standards.

## WHY VALCOR

## "We Do The Hard Stuff"

### [Why Choose Valcor][205]

We do the hard stuff, and we do it all in Springfield, NJ.  We have never turned down an application
because it was too difficult. Our specialty is in creating a component or system that meets and
exceeds our customer’s most complicated expectations. We have the creativity, legacy, and capability
to turn dreams into robust, reliable products. We can design and manufacture a component, or an
entire system around that component. Our turnkey systems provide our customers with substantial
value in the manufacturing, testing, and installation of those systems. We’re with you every step of
the way, from concept to production, and beyond.  Valcor’s FAA Repair Station provides routine
maintenance, or total refurbishment of all Valcor fluid control products.  We can even repair
products from other manufacturers. Valcor is the only partner you need to provide you with precision
fluid controls, motion controls, and systems.

### [What We Do][206]

We take your specifications and turn them into solutions that work for you.  Relying on a
world-class, highly-creative engineering team that can use the best features from a large catalog of
fluid and motion control products, or create something totally new, gets results that customers
embrace.

Our experienced engineering team can develop applications ranging from commercial laundry soap
dispensing control to the complex roll thruster system on a spacecraft.  No project is too big, or
too small for us to develop. During the development of a new application, we dive deep into the
customer’s system that will use the new component. It is not unusual for us to help our clients
improve the design of their entire system. In many cases, we end up redesigning, and then building
the system in production. This provides our customer with a fully tested turnkey solution ready for
installation in the customer’s product. Our customers fully embrace this truly value-added benefit
of partnering with Valcor Engineering!

Our FAA Repair Station provides Factory-Fresh repairs or refurbishment of your fluid control
components to original specifications using only Valcor Engineering parts and procedures.  Your
factory-serviced component or system will provide you with years of additional service!

### [Why Should You Care][207]

Time is of the essence. Partnering with an industry leading, engineering-driven company who listens
to your needs, then turns them into products that work ensures that you meet your project timelines
without incurring timeline delays and costly redesigns. We get it right the first time!

trips at speeds in excess of 200 kts while carrying four adults and baggage in total comfort and
ramp presence styling. With the rear mounted engine, the noise, propeller turbulence, engine heat

crisp controls and excellent aerodynamic stability allows the Velocity to fly as if it was mounted
on rails, allowing you to travel long distances with minimal pilot load and still dogfight with the

The Velocity is a true high performance airplane with the ability to make 1000 mile cross country
trips at speeds in excess of 200 kts while carrying four adults and baggage in total comfort and
ramp presence styling. With the rear mounted engine, the noise, propeller turbulence, engine heat
and fumes are behind you, providing an atmosphere comparable to a modern sports sedan. Extremely
crisp controls and excellent aerodynamic stability allows the Velocity to fly as if it was mounted
on rails, allowing you to travel long distances with minimal pilot load and still dogfight with the
best of the two seat sport planes. Learn more below.
